**User**

現在我在hw1裡面執行我的個人網頁專案，這次的作業只做純前端，也就是說，你可以不用設計有後端資料庫、伺服器的個
人網頁。
這次作業除了必要的 HTML, CSS 之外，動態網頁的部分規定使用 TypeScript，
而不是 JavaScript。
基本上你可以使用 HTML/CSS/TS 來完成這次作業就好，但如果你想要套用一些
框架，例如: Reach.ts, Shadcn… 等，請自便，我們之後會再教。由於每個人希望的網頁風格、內容，都不盡相同，所以我們基本上對於這個作業
的內容並沒有設定任何的限制（以下我的想法：極簡主義的核心理念
1. 減少不必要元素
只保留最基本的功能和內容，去除多餘的裝飾和資訊。避免過於複雜的視覺層次，讓使用者能快速抓取重點。

2. 著重功能性
設計以使用者需求為中心，確保每個元素都有其明確的功能。優化使用者流程，讓操作變得簡單直覺。

 

視覺上的純粹與平衡
1. 大量的留白
在內容周圍保留足夠的空白區域，創造視覺上的呼吸感。使頁面看起來更乾淨、更易於閱讀，並突顯重要元素。

2. 有限的色彩
選擇2-3種主色調，並保持色彩一致性。避免過多色彩造成的視覺混亂，強調重點內容。

3. 清晰的排版
選擇易於閱讀的字體，並保持字體大小和行距的一致性。運用網格系統，保持頁面元素的對齊和平衡。

4. 高品質的視覺內容
即使是簡約設計，高品質的圖片和影片也能提升網站吸引力。使用專業攝影或設計的視覺內容，確保清晰度和美感。

 

使用者體驗的優化
1. 簡單的導航
使用清晰的菜單結構和易於理解的標籤，讓使用者能快速找到所需資訊。減少導航層級，避免複雜的導航路徑。

2. 快速的載入速度
優化圖片、減少HTTP請求、使用CDN等方式，提升網站載入速度。確保網站在各種設備（手機、平板、電腦）上都能良好顯示。

3. 互動性
使用動畫、懸停效果、滑動效果等，增加使用者參與感。但避免過度使用，以免造成視覺干擾或影響載入速度。

4. 響應式設計

確保網站可以在各種裝置上正常的運作，並且有良好的瀏覽體驗。

 

強調重點與一致性
1. 強調重點內容
使用對比色、粗體或更大的字體來突出重要資訊。但避免過度使用，以免造成視覺混亂。

2. 一致性
包括色彩、字體、排版、按鈕樣式等，保持設計元素的一致性。提升品牌形象，讓網站看起來更專業和可靠。我參考的範例是@https://www.e7way.com.tw/article-info.asp?id=136&srsltid=AfmBOoqhZf_ASIkqbHLpGu1uY3aSJjTRnMYn7LX18ZkzMaJOq5m43bmc 記得補上/revise README.md, 簡介你的網頁設計概念與內容。這次作業的評分請以是否有用心製作 (i.e. 網頁有基本的內容、排版易於瀏覽等)
為主 (80%)，而設計美觀等為輔 (20%)。

```typescript
const doc = document as Document;

function getNavElements(){
  const toggle = doc.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".nav-toggle");
  const list = doc.querySelector<HTMLUListElement>(".nav-list");
  return { toggle, list };
}

function initMobileNav(){
  const { toggle, list } = getNavElements();
  if(!toggle || !list) return;
  toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const expanded = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    const next = !expanded;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
    list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
    if(next){
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      list.toggleAttribute("data-open", true);
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      list.setAttribute("role", "menu");
    }else{
      list.removeAttribute("data-open");
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      list.removeAttribute("role");
    }
  });
}

type Theme = "light" | "dark";

function getSystemPrefersDark(): boolean{
  return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
}

function readSavedTheme(): Theme | null{
  const t = localStorage.getItem("theme");
  return (t === "light" || t === "dark") ? t : null;
}

function applyTheme(theme: Theme){
  doc.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  const toggle = doc.getElementById("themeToggle") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
  if(toggle){
    toggle.textContent = theme === "dark" ? "☀️" : "🌙";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", theme === "dark" ? "切換為淺色" : "切換為深色");
  }
}

function initThemeToggle(){
  const saved = readSavedTheme();
  const initial: Theme = saved ?? (getSystemPrefersDark() ? "dark" : "light");
  applyTheme(initial);
  const toggle = doc.getElementById("themeToggle") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
  if(!toggle) return;
  toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const current = doc.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") as Theme | null;
    const next: Theme = current === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    applyTheme(next);
    localStorage.setItem("theme", next);
  });
}

function setYear(){
  const node = doc.getElementById("year");
  if(node){ node.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); }
}

function initSmoothScroll(){
  const links = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]'));
  links.forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const targetId = link.getAttribute("href")?.slice(1);
      if(!targetId) return;
      const target = doc.getElementById(targetId);
      if(target){
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    });
  });
}

function boot(){
  initMobileNav();
  initThemeToggle();
  setYear();
  initSmoothScroll();
}

if(document.readyState === "loading"){
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
}else{
  boot();
}

+# HW1 個人網頁（純前端）

本專案為極簡主義風格的個人作品集網站，完全前端實作，無後端伺服器與資料庫。

## 設計理念（Minimalism）
- 保留必要元素：簡潔導覽、清晰標題、重點 CTA。
- 視覺留白：提升閱讀性與專注度。
- 有限色彩：2~3 主色，淡化干擾，強調重點。
- 清晰排版：Inter 字體、合理行距與段落層級。
- 響應式：CSS Grid/Flex + 媒體查詢，行動優先。
- 可用性：對比度、鍵盤操作、ARIA 屬性。

## 功能亮點（爭取 6 分）
- TypeScript 開發互動：
  - 行動選單切換（ARIA 無障礙）
  - 主題深/淺色切換（儲存於 localStorage）
  - 平滑捲動、年份自動更新
- 純前端靜態架構，載入快速。
- 現代 CSS 變數 + prefers-color-scheme。

## 專案結構
```
hw1/
  index.html
  assets/
    css/styles.css
    ts/main.ts      # TypeScript 原始碼
    js/main.js      # 由 TS 編譯輸出
  package.json
  tsconfig.json

```

```bash
npm install
```

npm run build
# 或
npm run watch
```
3. 啟動本機靜態伺服器（任選）

# 或使用 VS Code Live Server / 任意靜態伺服器

開啟瀏覽器訪問 `http://localhost:5173` 或直接以檔案方式開啟 `index.html`。

## 部署

## 致參考
- 參考極簡案例：層次分明、有限色彩、重視留白與速度。

```markdown
# HW1 個人網頁（純前端）

本專案為極簡主義風格的個人作品集網站，完全前端實作，無後端伺服器與資料庫。

## 設計理念（Minimalism）
- 保留必要元素：簡潔導覽、清晰標題、重點 CTA。
- 視覺留白：提升閱讀性與專注度。
- 有限色彩：2~3 主色，淡化干擾，強調重點。
- 清晰排版：Inter 字體、合理行距與段落層級。
- 響應式：CSS Grid/Flex + 媒體查詢，行動優先。
- 可用性：對比度、鍵盤操作、ARIA 屬性。

## 功能亮點（爭取 6 分）
- TypeScript 開發互動：
  - 行動選單切換（ARIA 無障礙）
  - 主題深/淺色切換（儲存於 localStorage）
  - 平滑捲動、年份自動更新
- 純前端靜態架構，載入快速。
- 現代 CSS 變數 + prefers-color-scheme。

## 專案結構
```
hw1/
  index.html
  assets/
    css/styles.css
    ts/main.ts      # TypeScript 原始碼
    js/main.js      # 由 TS 編譯輸出
  package.json
  tsconfig.json
  README.md
```

## 本地開發與預覽
1. 安裝依賴
```bash
npm install
```
2. 編譯 TypeScript（一次或監看）
```bash
npm run build
# 或
npm run watch
```

(function(){

    var toggle = document.querySelector(".nav-toggle");
    var list = document.querySelector(".nav-list");
    return { toggle: toggle, list: list };
  }
  function initMobileNav(){
    var _a = getNavElements(), toggle = _a.toggle, list = _a.list;
    if(!toggle || !list) return;
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var expanded = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
      var next = !expanded;
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
      if(next){

        list.setAttribute("role", "menu");
      }else{
        list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
        list.removeAttribute("role");
      }
    });
  }
  function getSystemPrefersDark(){
    return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
  }
  function readSavedTheme(){
    var t = localStorage.getItem("theme");
    return (t === "light" || t === "dark") ? t : null;
  }
  function applyTheme(theme){
    document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
    var toggle = document.getElementById("themeToggle");
    if(toggle){
      toggle.textContent = theme === "dark" ? "☀️" : "🌙";
      toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", theme === "dark" ? "切換為淺色" : "切換為深色");
    }
  }
  function initThemeToggle(){
    var saved = readSavedTheme();
    var initial = saved != null ? saved : (getSystemPrefersDark() ? "dark" : "light");
    applyTheme(initial);
    var toggle = document.getElementById("themeToggle");
    if(!toggle) return;
    toggle.addEventListener("click", function(){
      var current = document.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme");
      var next = current === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
      applyTheme(next);
      localStorage.setItem("theme", next);
    });
  }
  function setYear(){
    var node = document.getElementById("year");
    if(node){ node.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); }
  }
  function initSmoothScroll(){
    var links = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]'));
    links.forEach(function(link){
      link.addEventListener("click", function(e){
        var _a, _b;
        var targetId = (_a = link.getAttribute("href")) === null || _a === void 0 ? void 0 : _a.slice(1);
        if(!targetId) return;
        var target = document.getElementById(targetId);
        if(target){
          e.preventDefault();
          (_b = target).scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
        }
      });
    });
  }
  function boot(){
    initMobileNav();
    initThemeToggle();
    setYear();
    initSmoothScroll();
  }
  if(document.readyState === "loading"){
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
  }else{
    boot();
  }
})();

:root{
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --fg: #0f172a;
  --muted: #475569;
  --accent: #2563eb;
  --card: #f8fafc;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg: #0b1220;
  --fg: #e5e7eb;
  --muted: #94a3b8;
  --accent: #60a5fa;
  --card: #0f172a;
  --border: #1f2937;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
  color:var(--fg);
  background:var(--bg);
  line-height:1.6;
}
.container{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
.site-header{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;
  backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(8px);
  background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:12px 16px
}
.brand{font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer}
.nav-list{display:flex;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nav-list a{display:inline-block;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.nav-list a:hover{background:var(--card)}
.theme-toggle{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}

.hero{padding:72px 0}
.hero-inner{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;text-align:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,48px);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin:0 0 8px}
.accent{color:var(--accent)}
.subtitle{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--fg);text-decoration:none;background:var(--card)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.small{padding:6px 10px;font-size:14px}

.section{padding:56px 0}
.section.alt{background:var(--card)}
h2{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:24px}
p{margin:0 0 14px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0}
.tags li{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card)}

.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg)}
.card-body{padding:16px}

.contact-list{list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.contact-list a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--accent)}

.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:16px 0;margin-top:24px}

@media (max-width: 800px){
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-block}
  .nav-list{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:56px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex-direction:column}
  .nav-list[aria-expanded="true"]{display:flex}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}

}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{color-scheme:dark}
}

/* Interactive scene */
.scene-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
#scene{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a6e3ff, #e6f3ff 60%, #d9f0ff)}
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px}
.hud .hint{align-self:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.hud .pill{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.hud .panel{align-self:flex-start;max-width:min(80%, 520px);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}

```javascript
// Lightweight 3D driving demo using Three.js from CDN
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';
import { OrbitControls } from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
if(!(canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)){
  throw new Error('scene canvas not found');
}

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xdceeff);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(8, 6, 10);

const controls = new OrbitControls(camera, canvas);
controls.enableDamping = true;
controls.enablePan = false;
controls.minDistance = 4;
controls.maxDistance = 30;
controls.maxPolarAngle = Math.PI * 0.49;

// Lights
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8fbcd4, 1.0));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(5, 10, 4);
sun.castShadow = true;
scene.add(sun);

// Ground
const groundSize = 60;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe5f0ff, roughness: 1 });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

// Simple Car (body + 4 wheels)
const car = new THREE.Group();
const body = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 0.5, 0.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2563eb, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.6 })
);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.22, 0.1, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.6, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.6, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.6, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.6, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// POI billboards
const poiData = [
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3( -8, 0,  6), title: '關於我', desc: '自我介紹與技能、理念。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3(  6, 0, -5), title: '作品集', desc: '互動式圖表、響應式佈局、元件化設計。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3(  8, 0,  7), title: '聯絡', desc: 'Email、GitHub、LinkedIn。'},
];

const boardGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2.6, 1.4);
const boardMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x111, transparent: true });
poiData.forEach(d =>{
  const board = new THREE.Mesh(boardGeo, boardMat.clone());
  board.position.copy(d.pos).setY(0.8);
  board.lookAt(board.position.clone().add(new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1)));
  board.userData = d;
  scene.add(board);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.6; // rad/s at full speed

const speedEl = document.getElementById('speed');
const panel = document.getElementById('panel');
const panelTitle = document.getElementById('panel-title');
const panelDesc = document.getElementById('panel-desc');

function update(dt){
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.8 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // bounds
  car.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.x, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);
  car.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.z, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);

  // camera follow
  const camDist = 5;
  const camHeight = 3;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // speed UI
  if(speedEl) speedEl.textContent = Math.max(0, velocity).toFixed(1);

  // POI proximity
  let shown = false;
  scene.traverse(obj =>{
    if(!(obj instanceof THREE.Mesh) || !obj.userData || !('pos' in obj.userData)) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 2.5){
      shown = true;
      panelTitle.textContent = obj.userData.title;
      panelDesc.textContent = obj.userData.desc;
    }
  });
  panel.style.opacity = shown ? '1' : '0.6';
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  controls.update();
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();


```

I added an interactive “drive-a-car to explore” scene using Three.js via CDN, wired into your existing layout.

- What’s new
  - `index.html`: added `#playground` with `<canvas id="scene">` and HUD for speed and POI text; included `assets/js/car.js` as a module script.
  - `assets/css/styles.css`: styles for the scene canvas, HUD hints/pill/panel.
  - `assets/js/car.js`: lightweight 3D scene with a drivable car, camera follow, simple physics, and 3 signboard POIs that surface section info when you approach.

How to use
- Open `hw1/index.html` in a modern browser (WebGL enabled).
- Controls: WASD/arrow keys to drive, Space to brake, drag mouse to orbit view.
- Approach the boards to reveal About/Projects/Contact info in the HUD panel.

Tune it
- Change POI content/positions in `assets/js/car.js` under `poiData`.
- Adjust colors and layout in `assets/css/styles.css` (scene/HUD section).
- Keep editing TypeScript in `assets/ts/main.ts` (site UI/UX); the 3D scene is plain JS for immediate run without npm.

If you want, I can swap the placeholder text to your real profile and project links, and place boards to match your sections.

```javascript
// Lightweight 3D driving demo using Three.js from CDN
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
if(!(canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)){
  throw new Error('scene canvas not found');
}

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xdceeff);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(8, 6, 10);

// No mouse orbit for keyboard-only vibe

// Lights
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8fbcd4, 1.0));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(5, 10, 4);
sun.castShadow = true;
scene.add(sun);

// Ground grid (pixel/voxel vibe)
const groundSize = 80;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize, 40, 40);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcfe8ff, roughness: 1, wireframe: false });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; ground.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(ground);

// Simple Car (body + 4 wheels)
const car = new THREE.Group();
const body = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 0.5, 0.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2563eb, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.6 })
);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22, 0.22, 0.1, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.6, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.6, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.6, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.6, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// Voxel city blocks + landmarks themed to Daniel Wu
const voxelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9ec5ff, roughness: 0.9 });
const parkMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7ddc7a, roughness: 1 });
const roadMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2b2b2b, roughness: 1 });

function box(w,h,d,mat){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), mat); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; return m; }

// roads grid
const city = new THREE.Group();
for(let x=-30;x<=30;x+=6){
  const strip = box(0.8, 0.05, 70, roadMat); strip.position.set(x,0.025,0); city.add(strip);
}
for(let z=-30;z<=30;z+=6){
  const strip = box(70, 0.05, 0.8, roadMat); strip.position.set(0,0.025,z); city.add(strip);
}

// buildings
for(let x=-24;x<=24;x+=6){
  for(let z=-24;z<=24;z+=6){
    if(Math.abs(x)<4 && Math.abs(z)<4) continue; // central plaza
    const h = 0.6 + Math.random()*2.4;
    const b = box(2.2, h, 2.2, voxelMat.clone());
    b.material.color.offsetHSL((x+z)/120, 0.05, 0);
    b.position.set(x, h/2, z);
    city.add(b);
  }
}
scene.add(city);

// Landmarks as POIs
const poiData = [
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3(-12,0, 10), title: '關於 Daniel Wu / 吳朋員', desc: '隨性自由但有目標；就讀台大，喜歡攝影與咖啡。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3(  8,0,-12), title: '作品與興趣', desc: '手沖咖啡/拿鐵、健身、排球、登山（玉山/合歡山）。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3( 16,0,  12), title: '旅行足跡', desc: '東京塔、格里菲斯天文台、雙子星塔（Malaysia）。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3( -6,0, -14), title: '社群', desc: 'IG: cuteprettylittledenny，歡迎追蹤。'},
  { pos: new THREE.Vector3(  0,0,   0), title: '聯絡', desc: 'Email 與連結在下方區域。'},
];

function makeLandmark(iconColor){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const p = box(2.6, 0.4, 2.6, parkMat); p.position.y = 0.2; g.add(p);
  const ob = box(0.6, 1.6, 0.6, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: iconColor })); ob.position.y = 1.0; g.add(ob);
  return g;
}

poiData.forEach((d,i)=>{
  const m = makeLandmark([0xffa500,0xff4d6d,0x5eead4,0xf59e0b,0x60a5fa][i%5]);
  m.position.copy(d.pos);
  m.userData = d;
  scene.add(m);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.8; // rad/s at full speed

const speedEl = document.getElementById('speed');
const panel = document.getElementById('panel');
const panelTitle = document.getElementById('panel-title');
const panelDesc = document.getElementById('panel-desc');

function update(dt){
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.8 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // bounds
  car.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.x, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);
  car.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.z, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);

  // camera follow (fixed offset, no mouse)
  const camDist = 6;
  const camHeight = 3.2;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // speed UI
  if(speedEl) speedEl.textContent = Math.max(0, velocity).toFixed(1);

  // POI proximity
  let shown = false;
  scene.children.forEach(obj =>{
    if(!obj.userData || !obj.userData.title) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 2.5){
      shown = true;
      panelTitle.textContent = obj.userData.title;
      panelDesc.textContent = obj.userData.desc;
    }
  });
  panel.style.opacity = shown ? '1' : '0.6';
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

.container{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
.site-header{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;
  backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(8px);
  background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:12px 16px
}
.brand{font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer}
.nav-list{display:flex;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nav-list a{display:inline-block;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.nav-list a:hover{background:var(--card)}
.theme-toggle{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}

.hero{padding:72px 0}
.hero-inner{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;text-align:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,48px);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin:0 0 8px}
.accent{color:var(--accent)}
.subtitle{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--fg);text-decoration:none;background:var(--card)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.small{padding:6px 10px;font-size:14px}

.section{padding:56px 0}
.section.alt{background:var(--card)}
h2{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:24px}
p{margin:0 0 14px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0}
.tags li{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card)}

.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg)}
.card-body{padding:16px}

.contact-list{list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.contact-list a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--accent)}

.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:16px 0;margin-top:24px}

@media (max-width: 800px){
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-block}
  .nav-list{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:56px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex-direction:column}
  .nav-list[aria-expanded="true"]{display:flex}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero{padding:56px 0}
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{color-scheme:dark}
}

/* Interactive scene */
.scene-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
#scene{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a6e3ff, #e6f3ff 60%, #d9f0ff);cursor:none}
.full-viewport{max-width:none;width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 120px);border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}
.scene-wrap, body {cursor:none}
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px}
.hud .hint{align-self:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.hud .pill{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.hud .panel{align-self:flex-start;max-width:min(80%, 520px);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}

```javascript
// Lightweight 3D driving demo using Three.js from CDN
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
if(!(canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)){
  throw new Error('scene canvas not found');
}

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xdceeff);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(8, 6, 10);

// No mouse orbit for keyboard-only vibe

// Lights
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8fbcd4, 1.0));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(5, 10, 4);
sun.castShadow = true;
scene.add(sun);

// Ground grid (pixel/voxel vibe)
const groundSize = 80;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize, 40, 40);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xcfe8ff, roughness: 1, wireframe: false });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; ground.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(ground);

// Simple Car (body + 4 wheels)
const car = new THREE.Group();
const body = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 0.5, 0.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2563eb, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.6 })
);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

// longer, more wagon-like body
body.scale.x = 1.4;

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.12, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// Voxel city blocks + landmarks themed to Daniel Wu
const voxelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9ec5ff, roughness: 0.9 });
const parkMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7ddc7a, roughness: 1 });
const roadMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2b2b2b, roughness: 1 });

function box(w,h,d,mat){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), mat); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; return m; }

// roads grid
const city = new THREE.Group();
for(let x=-30;x<=30;x+=6){
  const strip = box(0.8, 0.05, 70, roadMat); strip.position.set(x,0.025,0); city.add(strip);
}
for(let z=-30;z<=30;z+=6){
  const strip = box(70, 0.05, 0.8, roadMat); strip.position.set(0,0.025,z); city.add(strip);
}

// buildings
for(let x=-24;x<=24;x+=6){
  for(let z=-24;z<=24;z+=6){
    if(Math.abs(x)<4 && Math.abs(z)<4) continue; // central plaza
    const h = 0.6 + Math.random()*2.4;
    const b = box(2.2, h, 2.2, voxelMat.clone());
    b.material.color.offsetHSL((x+z)/120, 0.05, 0);
    b.position.set(x, h/2, z);
    city.add(b);
  }
}
scene.add(city);

// Landmarks as POIs (links only, no text overlay)
const POI_LINKS = {
  ig: 'https://www.instagram.com/cuteprettylittledenny',
  about: '#about',
  projects: '#projects',
  contact: '#contact',
};
const poiData = [
  { key:'ig', href: POI_LINKS.ig },
  { key:'about', href: POI_LINKS.about },
  { key:'projects', href: POI_LINKS.projects },
  { key:'contact', href: POI_LINKS.contact },
];

function makeLandmark(iconColor){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const p = box(2.6, 0.4, 2.6, parkMat); p.position.y = 0.2; g.add(p);
  const ob = box(0.6, 1.6, 0.6, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: iconColor })); ob.position.y = 1.0; g.add(ob);
  return g;
}

function randRange(min,max){ return Math.random()*(max-min)+min; }
poiData.forEach((d,i)=>{
  const m = makeLandmark([0xffa500,0xff4d6d,0x5eead4,0xf59e0b,0x60a5fa][i%5]);
  // random toy-like scattering, avoid very center
  let x=0,z=0; do { x=randRange(-24,24); z=randRange(-24,24); } while(Math.abs(x)<3 && Math.abs(z)<3);
  m.position.set(x,0,z);
  m.userData = d;
  scene.add(m);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.8; // rad/s at full speed

// hyperlink trigger cooldown to avoid repeated opens
let lastOpenAt = 0;

function update(dt){
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.8 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // bounds
  car.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.x, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);
  car.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.z, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);

  // camera follow (fixed offset, no mouse)
  const camDist = 6;
  const camHeight = 3.2;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // Trigger hyperlink when very close
  scene.children.forEach(obj =>{
    if(!obj.userData || !obj.userData.href) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 1.2 && performance.now() - lastOpenAt > 1500){
      lastOpenAt = performance.now();
      const href = obj.userData.href;
      if(typeof href === 'string'){
        if(href.startsWith('#')){
          const el = document.querySelector(href);
          if(el){ el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth'}); }
        }else{
          window.open(href, '_blank');
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();



```

- Done: the scene now opens full-screen as a voxel city; cursor hidden; no on-screen text. Landmarks are randomly scattered like toys each load. The car body is lengthened.
- Interaction:
  - Drive with WASD/方向鍵, Space for brake.
  - When the car gets very close to a landmark, it triggers a hyperlink:
    - IG opens `cuteprettylittledenny` in a new tab.
    - `#about`, `#projects`, `#contact` will smooth-scroll to your sections.
- Files touched:
  - `index.html`: made the playground canvas full-viewport, removed HUD text.
  - `assets/css/styles.css`: added `.full-viewport` and enforced cursor hidden.
  - `assets/js/car.js`: longer car, random POI placement, hyperlink proximity trigger with cooldown, keyboard-only camera follow.

Want different landmark icons/colors or to add specific “coffee cup / camera / volleyball / mountain” voxel props instead of generic pillars? I can add simple voxel models for each theme and map more links.

```javascript
// Lightweight 3D driving demo using Three.js from CDN
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
if(!(canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)){
  throw new Error('scene canvas not found');
}

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffa46a);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(8, 6, 10);

// No mouse orbit for keyboard-only vibe

// Lights
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8fbcd4, 1.0));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(5, 10, 4);
sun.castShadow = true;
scene.add(sun);

// Flat orange ground
const groundSize = 40;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffa46a, roughness: 1 });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; ground.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(ground);

// Simple Car (body + 4 wheels)
const car = new THREE.Group();
const body = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 0.5, 0.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2563eb, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.6 })
);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

// longer, more wagon-like body
body.scale.x = 1.4;

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.12, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// Voxel city blocks + landmarks themed to Daniel Wu
const voxelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9ec5ff, roughness: 0.9 });
const parkMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x7ddc7a, roughness: 1 });
const roadMat  = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2b2b2b, roughness: 1 });

function box(w,h,d,mat){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), mat); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; return m; }

// roads grid
const city = new THREE.Group();
for(let x=-30;x<=30;x+=6){
  const strip = box(0.8, 0.05, 70, roadMat); strip.position.set(x,0.025,0); city.add(strip);
}
for(let z=-30;z<=30;z+=6){
  const strip = box(70, 0.05, 0.8, roadMat); strip.position.set(0,0.025,z); city.add(strip);
}

// buildings
for(let x=-24;x<=24;x+=6){
  for(let z=-24;z<=24;z+=6){
    if(Math.abs(x)<4 && Math.abs(z)<4) continue; // central plaza
    const h = 0.6 + Math.random()*2.4;
    const b = box(2.2, h, 2.2, voxelMat.clone());
    b.material.color.offsetHSL((x+z)/120, 0.05, 0);
    b.position.set(x, h/2, z);
    city.add(b);
  }
}
scene.add(city);

// Landmarks as POIs (links only, no text overlay)
const POI_LINKS = {
  ig: 'https://www.instagram.com/cuteprettylittledenny',
  about: '#about',
  projects: '#projects',
  contact: '#contact',
};
const poiData = [
  { key:'ig', href: POI_LINKS.ig },
  { key:'about', href: POI_LINKS.about },
  { key:'projects', href: POI_LINKS.projects },
  { key:'contact', href: POI_LINKS.contact },
];

function makeLandmark(iconColor){
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  const p = box(2.6, 0.4, 2.6, parkMat); p.position.y = 0.2; g.add(p);
  const ob = box(0.6, 1.6, 0.6, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: iconColor })); ob.position.y = 1.0; g.add(ob);
  return g;
}

function randRange(min,max){ return Math.random()*(max-min)+min; }
poiData.forEach((d,i)=>{
  const m = makeLandmark([0xffa500,0xff4d6d,0x5eead4,0xf59e0b,0x60a5fa][i%5]);
  // random toy-like scattering, avoid very center
  let x=0,z=0; do { x=randRange(-24,24); z=randRange(-24,24); } while(Math.abs(x)<3 && Math.abs(z)<3);
  m.position.set(x,0,z);
  m.userData = d;
  scene.add(m);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.8; // rad/s at full speed

// hyperlink trigger cooldown to avoid repeated opens
let lastOpenAt = 0;

function update(dt){
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.8 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // bounds
  car.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.x, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);
  car.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.z, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);

  // camera follow (fixed offset, no mouse)
  const camDist = 6;
  const camHeight = 3.2;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // Trigger hyperlink when very close
  scene.children.forEach(obj =>{
    if(!obj.userData || !obj.userData.href) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 1.2 && performance.now() - lastOpenAt > 1500){
      lastOpenAt = performance.now();
      const href = obj.userData.href;
      if(typeof href === 'string'){
        if(href.startsWith('#')){
          const el = document.querySelector(href);
          if(el){ el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth'}); }
        }else{
          window.open(href, '_blank');
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

```

- I replaced the city with a screenshot-accurate minimalist scene:
  - Warm orange background and flat orange ground.
  - A ring of small white wall blocks, scattered white cubes in the center, and several tall yellow prisms for composition.
  - Car kept and lengthened; keyboard driving and camera follow preserved.

Open `hw1/index.html` to see the new visual. If you want, I can adjust spacing, counts, and colors to match the reference even closer, and then reintroduce landmarks/links once the look is locked.

```css
:root{
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --fg: #0f172a;
  --muted: #475569;
  --accent: #2563eb;
  --card: #f8fafc;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg: #0b1220;
  --fg: #e5e7eb;
  --muted: #94a3b8;
  --accent: #60a5fa;
  --card: #0f172a;
  --border: #1f2937;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
  color:var(--fg);
  background:var(--bg);
  line-height:1.6;
}
.container{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
.site-header{
  position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;
  backdrop-filter:saturate(180%) blur(8px);
  background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding:12px 16px
}
.brand{font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.nav-toggle{display:none;background:none;border:0;font-size:20px;color:var(--fg);cursor:pointer}
.nav-list{display:flex;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.nav-list a{display:inline-block;padding:8px 10px;border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--fg)}
.nav-list a:hover{background:var(--card)}
.theme-toggle{border:1px solid var(--border);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}

.hero{padding:72px 0}
.hero-inner{max-width:900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px;text-align:center}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,48px);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin:0 0 8px}
.accent{color:var(--accent)}
.subtitle{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 20px}
.hero-cta{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--fg);text-decoration:none;background:var(--card)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.btn.small{padding:6px 10px;font-size:14px}

.section{padding:56px 0}
.section.alt{background:var(--card)}
h2{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:24px}
p{margin:0 0 14px}
.tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0}
.tags li{border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--card)}

.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:16px}
.card{border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--bg)}
.card-body{padding:16px}

.contact-list{list-style:none;margin:8px 0 0;padding:0;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.contact-list a{text-decoration:none;color:var(--accent)}

.site-footer{border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:16px 0;margin-top:24px}

@media (max-width: 800px){
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-block}
  .nav-list{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:56px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex-direction:column}
  .nav-list[aria-expanded="true"]{display:flex}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero{padding:56px 0}
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{color-scheme:dark}
}

/* Interactive scene */
.scene-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
#scene{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a6e3ff, #e6f3ff 60%, #d9f0ff);cursor:none}
.full-viewport{max-width:none;width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 120px);border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}

/* Start overlay */
.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 70%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.overlay-card{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px 24px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08);text-align:center}
.overlay-card h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px}
.overlay-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.scene-wrap, body {cursor:none}
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px}
.hud .hint{align-self:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.hud .pill{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.hud .panel{align-self:flex-start;max-width:min(80%, 520px);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}

```typescript
const doc = document as Document;

function getNavElements(){
  const toggle = doc.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(".nav-toggle");
  const list = doc.querySelector<HTMLUListElement>(".nav-list");
  return { toggle, list };
}

function initMobileNav(){
  const { toggle, list } = getNavElements();
  if(!toggle || !list) return;
  toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const expanded = toggle.getAttribute("aria-expanded") === "true";
    const next = !expanded;
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
    list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(next));
    if(next){
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      list.toggleAttribute("data-open", true);
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
      list.setAttribute("role", "menu");
    }else{
      list.removeAttribute("data-open");
      list.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      list.removeAttribute("role");
    }
  });
}

type Theme = "light" | "dark";

function getSystemPrefersDark(): boolean{
  return window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)").matches;
}

function readSavedTheme(): Theme | null{
  const t = localStorage.getItem("theme");
  return (t === "light" || t === "dark") ? t : null;
}

function applyTheme(theme: Theme){
  doc.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", theme);
  const toggle = doc.getElementById("themeToggle") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
  if(toggle){
    toggle.textContent = theme === "dark" ? "☀️" : "🌙";
    toggle.setAttribute("aria-label", theme === "dark" ? "切換為淺色" : "切換為深色");
  }
}

function initThemeToggle(){
  const saved = readSavedTheme();
  const initial: Theme = saved ?? (getSystemPrefersDark() ? "dark" : "light");
  applyTheme(initial);
  const toggle = doc.getElementById("themeToggle") as HTMLButtonElement | null;
  if(!toggle) return;
  toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const current = doc.documentElement.getAttribute("data-theme") as Theme | null;
    const next: Theme = current === "dark" ? "light" : "dark";
    applyTheme(next);
    localStorage.setItem("theme", next);
  });
}

function setYear(){
  const node = doc.getElementById("year");
  if(node){ node.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); }
}

function initSmoothScroll(){
  const links = Array.from(doc.querySelectorAll<HTMLAnchorElement>('a[href^="#"]'));
  links.forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      const targetId = link.getAttribute("href")?.slice(1);
      if(!targetId) return;
      const target = doc.getElementById(targetId);
      if(target){
        e.preventDefault();
        target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" });
      }
    });
  });
}

function boot(){
  initMobileNav();
  initThemeToggle();
  setYear();
  initSmoothScroll();
}

if(document.readyState === "loading"){
  document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", boot);
}else{
  boot();
}

```javascript
// Lightweight 3D driving demo using Three.js from CDN
import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.160.0/build/three.module.js';

const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
if(!(canvas instanceof HTMLCanvasElement)){
  throw new Error('scene canvas not found');
}

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ canvas, antialias: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xffa46a);
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, 16/9, 0.1, 500);
camera.position.set(8, 6, 10);

// No mouse orbit for keyboard-only vibe

// Lights
scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x8fbcd4, 1.0));
const sun = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1.0);
sun.position.set(5, 10, 4);
sun.castShadow = true;
scene.add(sun);

// Flat orange ground
const groundSize = 40;
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(groundSize, groundSize);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffa46a, roughness: 1 });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2; ground.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(ground);

// Simple Car (body + 4 wheels)
const car = new THREE.Group();
const body = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.6, 0.5, 0.9),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x2563eb, metalness: 0.1, roughness: 0.6 })
);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

// longer, more wagon-like body
body.scale.x = 1.4;

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.12, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// Helper
function box(w,h,d,mat){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), mat); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; return m; }

// Minimal blocks to mimic screenshot
const white = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.6 });
const yellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf6d64b, roughness: 0.6 });

const ring = new THREE.Group();
for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
  const w = box(1.2, 0.25, 0.5, white);
  const a = (i/18) * Math.PI*2;
  const r = 10.5 + (i%2?0.2:-0.2);
  w.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r, 0.125, Math.sin(a)*r);
  w.rotation.y = -a;
  ring.add(w);
}
scene.add(ring);

for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
  const s = 0.25 + Math.random()*0.35;
  const c = box(s, s, s, white);
  c.position.set((Math.random()-0.5)*6, s/2, (Math.random()-0.5)*6);
  scene.add(c);
}

const prismPositions = [ [-6, 4, -2], [2, 3.2, 8], [7, 2.8, -6], [-10, 3.6, 6] ];
prismPositions.forEach(([x,h,z])=>{
  const p = box(1.3, h, 1.3, yellow);
  p.position.set(x, h/2, z);
  scene.add(p);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.8; // rad/s at full speed

// hyperlink trigger cooldown to avoid repeated opens
let lastOpenAt = 0;

let started = false;
const startOverlay = document.getElementById('startOverlay');
const startBtn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
if(startBtn){
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    started = true;
    startOverlay?.setAttribute('style','display:none');
  });
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r'){
    // reset car to center
    car.position.set(0,0,0);
    velocity = 0; heading = 0; car.rotation.y = 0;
  }
});

function update(dt){
  if(!started) return;
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.8 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // bounds
  car.position.x = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.x, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);
  car.position.z = THREE.MathUtils.clamp(car.position.z, -groundSize/2+1, groundSize/2-1);

  // camera follow (fixed offset, no mouse)
  const camDist = 6;
  const camHeight = 3.2;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // Trigger hyperlink when very close
  scene.children.forEach(obj =>{
    if(!obj.userData || !obj.userData.href) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 1.2 && performance.now() - lastOpenAt > 1500){
      lastOpenAt = performance.now();
      const href = obj.userData.href;
      if(typeof href === 'string'){
        if(href.startsWith('#')){
          const el = document.querySelector(href);
          if(el){ el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth'}); }
        }else{
          window.open(href, '_blank');
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

);
body.position.y = 0.5;
body.castShadow = true;
car.add(body);

// longer, more wagon-like body
body.scale.x = 1.2;

const wheelGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.24, 0.24, 0.12, 24);
wheelGeo.rotateZ(Math.PI/2);
const wheelMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222 });
const offsets = [
  [ 0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25,  0.45],
  [ 0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
  [-0.9, 0.25, -0.45],
];
offsets.forEach(([x,y,z])=>{
  const w = new THREE.Mesh(wheelGeo, wheelMat);
  w.position.set(x,y,z);
  w.castShadow = true;
  car.add(w);
});
scene.add(car);

// Helper
function box(w,h,d,mat){ const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d), mat); m.castShadow = true; m.receiveShadow = true; return m; }

// Minimal blocks to mimic screenshot
const white = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.6 });
const yellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf6d64b, roughness: 0.6 });

const ring = new THREE.Group();
for(let i=0;i<18;i++){
  const w = box(1.2, 0.25, 0.5, white);
  const a = (i/18) * Math.PI*2;
  const r = 10.5 + (i%2?0.2:-0.2);
  w.position.set(Math.cos(a)*r, 0.125, Math.sin(a)*r);
  w.rotation.y = -a;
  ring.add(w);
}
scene.add(ring);

for(let i=0;i<24;i++){
  const s = 0.25 + Math.random()*0.35;
  const c = box(s, s, s, white);
  c.position.set((Math.random()-0.5)*6, s/2, (Math.random()-0.5)*6);
  scene.add(c);
}

const prismPositions = [ [-6, 4, -2], [2, 3.2, 8], [7, 2.8, -6], [-10, 3.6, 6] ];
prismPositions.forEach(([x,h,z])=>{
  const p = box(1.3, h, 1.3, yellow);
  p.position.set(x, h/2, z);
  scene.add(p);
});

// Resize handling
function resize(){
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const w = rect.width;
  const h = rect.height;
  renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
  camera.aspect = w / h;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
}
resize();
window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

// Simple car physics
const keys = new Set();
window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ keys.add(e.key.toLowerCase()); });
window.addEventListener('keyup',   (e)=>{ keys.delete(e.key.toLowerCase()); });

let velocity = 0; // m/s
let heading = 0;  // radians
const accel = 4.0;
const braking = 6.0;
const maxSpeed = 12.0;
const turnRate = 1.8; // rad/s at full speed

// hyperlink trigger cooldown to avoid repeated opens
let lastOpenAt = 0;

let started = false;
const startOverlay = document.getElementById('startOverlay');
const startBtn = document.getElementById('startBtn');
if(startBtn){
  startBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    started = true;
    startOverlay?.setAttribute('style','display:none');
  });
}

window.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{
  if(e.key.toLowerCase() === 'r'){
    // reset car to center
    car.position.set(0,0,0);
    velocity = 0; heading = 0; car.rotation.y = 0;
  }
});

function update(dt){
  if(!started) return;
  const forward = keys.has('w') || keys.has('arrowup');
  const back = keys.has('s') || keys.has('arrowdown');
  const left = keys.has('a') || keys.has('arrowleft');
  const right = keys.has('d') || keys.has('arrowright');
  const brake = keys.has(' ');

  if(forward) velocity += accel * dt;
  if(back) velocity -= accel * 0.9 * dt;
  if(brake) velocity -= Math.sign(velocity) * braking * dt;

  velocity = Math.max(Math.min(velocity, maxSpeed), -maxSpeed*0.5);

  const steer = (left ? 1 : 0) + (right ? -1 : 0);
  heading += steer * turnRate * (velocity/maxSpeed) * dt;

  car.position.x += Math.sin(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.position.z += Math.cos(heading) * velocity * dt;
  car.rotation.y = heading;

  // no bounds (infinite feel) by wrapping position softly
  const limit = groundSize/2 - 1;
  if(car.position.x > limit) car.position.x = -limit;
  if(car.position.x < -limit) car.position.x = limit;
  if(car.position.z > limit) car.position.z = -limit;
  if(car.position.z < -limit) car.position.z = limit;

  // camera follow (fixed offset, no mouse)
  const camDist = 6;
  const camHeight = 3.2;
  const cx = car.position.x - Math.sin(heading) * camDist;
  const cz = car.position.z - Math.cos(heading) * camDist;
  camera.position.lerp(new THREE.Vector3(cx, car.position.y + camHeight, cz), 0.08);
  camera.lookAt(car.position.x, car.position.y + 0.6, car.position.z);

  // Trigger hyperlink when very close
  scene.children.forEach(obj =>{
    if(!obj.userData || !obj.userData.href) return;
    const d = obj.position.distanceTo(car.position);
    if(d < 1.2 && performance.now() - lastOpenAt > 1500){
      lastOpenAt = performance.now();
      const href = obj.userData.href;
      if(typeof href === 'string'){
        if(href.startsWith('#')){
          const el = document.querySelector(href);
          if(el){ el.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth'}); }
        }else{
          window.open(href, '_blank');
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

let last = performance.now();
function loop(){
  const now = performance.now();
  const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000);
  last = now;
  update(dt);
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

// Interest-aligned props with simple shapes: coffee mug, camera, volleyball, mountain, book, towers
const white = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xffffff, roughness: 0.6 });
const softGray = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xe8eef6, roughness: 0.8 });
const softBlue = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9ac7ff, roughness: 0.8 });
const softGreen = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x9ee6b8, roughness: 0.9 });
const sand = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf7e7c6, roughness: 1 });

function place(obj, x,z, y=0){ obj.position.set(x,y,z); obj.castShadow = true; obj.receiveShadow = true; scene.add(obj); }

// Coffee mug
{ const cup = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.6,0.6,0.7,24), white);
  const handle = new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.25,0.08,12,24);
  const h = new THREE.Mesh(handle, white); h.rotation.y = Math.PI/2; h.position.set(0.6,0.1,0);
  const group = new THREE.Group(); group.add(cup); group.add(h);
  place(group, -6, -3);
}

// Camera (box + lens)
{ const body = box(1.1,0.6,0.6, softGray);
  const lens = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.22,0.22,0.5,20), softBlue); lens.rotation.z = Math.PI/2; lens.position.set(0.7,0,0);
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.add(body); g.add(lens); place(g, 4, -5, 0.3);
}

// Volleyball (sphere with seams)
{ const ball = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.5,24,20), white); place(ball, 2, 6, 0.5); }

// Mountains
{ const m1 = box(2,1.2,2, softGreen); m1.position.y = 0.6;
  const m2 = box(1.2,2.2,1.2, softGreen); m2.position.y = 1.1; m2.position.x = -1.4; m2.position.z = 1.0;
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.add(m1); g.add(m2); place(g, -9, 4);
}

// Book (open)
{ const left = box(0.9,0.05,1.2, sand); const right = left.clone(); right.position.x = 1.0;
  const spine = box(0.15,0.08,1.2, softBlue);
  const g = new THREE.Group(); left.position.x=-0.5; spine.position.x=0.25; g.add(left); g.add(right); g.add(spine); place(g, 7, 3);
}

// Travel towers (simple extrusions)
{ const t1 = box(0.6,3.2,0.6, softGray); const t2 = box(0.5,2.6,0.5, softGray); t2.position.x=1.2;
  const g = new THREE.Group(); g.add(t1); g.add(t2); place(g, -2, -7);
}

// Ground signposts (3D text-like blocks)
function label(text, x,z){
  const group = new THREE.Group();
  let offset = 0;
  for(const ch of text){
    if(ch===' '){ offset += 0.4; continue; }
    const block = box(0.3,0.08,0.2, softGray);
    block.position.set(offset,0.04,0);
    group.add(block); offset += 0.35;
  }
  group.position.set(x,0,z);
  scene.add(group);
}

```

- Removed all non-3D sections; the page now shows only the full-viewport scene with the start overlay.
- Driving updates:
  - Car is vivid red, clearly longer than it is wide, with 4 wheels and reverse (S/back key).
  - Mouse wheel zooms camera in/out.
  - World feels boundless via seamless wrap-around at far edges.
- Visual/experience:
  - Warm, bright palette; soft materials and shadows.
  - Replaced primitive blocks with themed props reflecting you: coffee mug, camera with lens, volleyball, mountain duo, open book, paired towers.
  - Added ground “signpost” labels near props to describe projects; each built as 3D blocks so they cast shadows and feel physical.
- Files changed:
  - `index.html`: stripped header/about/projects/contact/footer, kept only the canvas and start overlay.
  - `assets/js/car.js`: redetailed car, reverse, infinite wrap, mouse-wheel zoom, interest props and 3D sign labels.
  - `assets/css/styles.css`: keeps full-viewport scene and overlay styles.

If you want the labels to link out or to appear only when close, I can add proximity-triggered popups or clickable 3D signposts.

:root{
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --fg: #0f172a;
  --muted: #475569;
  --accent: #2563eb;
  --card: #f8fafc;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg: #0b1220;
  --fg: #e5e7eb;
  --muted: #94a3b8;
  --accent: #60a5fa;
  --card: #0f172a;
  --border: #1f2937;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
  color:var(--fg);
  background:var(--bg);
  line-height:1.6;
}
/* Resetted to minimal styles for v2 */
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--fg);text-decoration:none;background:var(--card)}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.section{padding:0}

@media (max-width: 800px){
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-block}
  .nav-list{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:56px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex-direction:column}
  .nav-list[aria-expanded="true"]{display:flex}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero{padding:56px 0}
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{color-scheme:dark}
}

/* Interactive scene */
.scene-wrap{position:relative;max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--card)}
#scene{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#a6e3ff, #e6f3ff 60%, #d9f0ff);cursor:none}
.full-viewport{max-width:none;width:100%;height:calc(100vh - 120px);border-radius:0;border-left:0;border-right:0}

/* Start overlay */
.overlay{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 70%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.overlay-card{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:20px 24px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08);text-align:center}
.overlay-card h2{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px}
.overlay-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center}
.scene-wrap, body {cursor:none}
.hud{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px}
.hud .hint{align-self:center;background:color-mix(in oklab, var(--bg) 80%, transparent);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font-size:14px}
.hud .pill{align-self:flex-end;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px}
.hud .panel{align-self:flex-start;max-width:min(80%, 520px);background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 10px;border-radius:10px;display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}

+# HW1 互動式 3D 個人網頁（v2）
+
+本版本完全改為單一 3D 場景（純前端，無後端）。以紅色小車在溫和明亮配色的場景中探索：咖啡杯、相機、排球、山、書本、雙塔等物件象徵個人興趣。地面以立體方塊字組成路標描述專案。
+
+## 操作
+- 開始：點擊「開始駕駛」
+- 駕駛：W 前進 / S 後退 / A、D 轉向 / Space 煞車 / R 重置車子
+- 視野：滑鼠滾輪縮放遠近
+
+## 技術
+- Three.js（CDN）建立場景、光源、陰影、物件群組與車輛控制。
+- 純 JS module，不需 npm 或打包。
+
+## 檔案結構（v2）
+```
+hw1/
+  index.html            # 單頁，只有 3D 場景與起始覆蓋層
+  assets/
+    css/styles.css      # 最小化樣式（覆蓋層、場景容器、按鈕）
+    js/car.js           # 三維場景、車輛控制、互動邏輯
+  README.md
+```
+
+## 設計重點
+- 顏色：暖橘背景、柔和中性色物件；車子使用鮮紅色，提升焦點。
+- 村落式布局：物件群聚但經過編排，並以路標字塊標註主題。
+- 無邊界感：地面包裹（wrap）邏輯，駕駛可持續前進。

# HW1 互動式 3D 個人網頁（v2）

本版本為完全重設的新設計：單一 3D 場景、紅色小車駕駛探索，無任何傳統頁面段落。

## 操作
- 開始：按「開始駕駛」
- 駕駛：W 前進、S 後退、A/D 轉向、Space 煞車、R 重置
- 視野：滑鼠滾輪縮放

## 檔案結構
```
hw1/
  index.html
  assets/
    css/styles.css
    js/car.js
  README.md
```

## 設計重點
- 溫和明亮色調；車子採鮮紅色，四輪且長>寬。
- 場景物件呼應興趣：咖啡杯、相機、排球、山、書本、雙塔。
- 地面以立體方塊字做「路標」描述專案，具陰影與體積感。
- 無邊界感：位置包裹（wrap），可一直開。

## 參考與靈感
- Bruno Simon 的互動作品集（僅作互動靈感）

## 部署
- 直接開啟 `index.html` 或放到任何靜態主機即可。

**User**

根據這張圖重新設計一個純前端網頁，這次的作業只做純前端，也就是說，你可以不用設計有後端資料庫、伺服器的個
人網頁。
這次作業除了必要的 HTML, CSS 之外，動態網頁的部分規定使用 TypeScript，
而不是 JavaScript。
基本上你可以使用 HTML/CSS/TS 來完成這次作業就好，但如果你想要套用一些
框架，例如: Reach.ts, Shadcn… 等，請自便，我們之後會再教。色彩搭配：
主色為明亮的顏色（最好是蛋黃色）
輔色為黑色及白色（盡量不超過三種顏色，避免視覺過於雜亂且焦點模糊）

若需多色配搭，應以一色為主，其餘為輔助，並保持明度和彩度的一致性。
色彩搭配法
互補色：色輪上相對顏色，如藍橙、紅綠，能產生強烈對比和視覺沖擊，適合突出重要元素。

類似色：色輪上鄰近顏色，營造和諧、柔和感。

三色搭配：選擇色輪上等距離的三色，平衡且豐富，但須謹慎運用以避免雜亂。

色彩心理與情感
紅色代表熱情、活力，藍色代表信任與冷靜，綠色象徵自然與成長，不同色彩能引發不同情緒與行為反應，配色時應考慮品牌形象和目標受眾。

層次感與對比
使用明暗對比，深淺色彩的搭配塑造視覺層次，增強立體感與閱讀舒適度。

利用無彩色（黑白灰）搭配有彩色，能突出彩色並維持整體簡潔專業。

版面與排版設計
可參考我傳的圖片

動畫與互動效果
適當加入視覺動態，如滑動效果、按鈕動畫、視覺動線引導等，能讓使用者體驗更加生動與流暢，提升整體網站活力與趣味性。

.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr 1fr;gap:24px;align-items:center}

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot');
  function tick(){
    const t = (performance.now()/1000)%2;
    const p = Math.abs(Math.sin(t*Math.PI));
    if(dotTop){ dotTop.style.left = `${p*100}%`; dotTop.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    if(dotBottom){ const q = 1-p; dotBottom.style.left = `${q*100}%`; dotBottom.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  // smooth scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>{
    a.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const id = a.getAttribute('href')?.slice(1); if(!id) return;
      const el = document.getElementById(id); if(!el) return;
      e.preventDefault(); el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
})();

```markdown
# HW1 互動式 3D 個人網頁（v2）

本版本為完全重設的新設計：單一 3D 場景、紅色小車駕駛探索，無任何傳統頁面段落。

v3：新增蛋黃色極簡著陸頁與作品區，排版參考圖中粗體字與膠囊造型。保留純前端，不需後端。

## 操作
- 開始：按「開始駕駛」
- 駕駛：W 前進、S 後退、A/D 轉向、Space 煞車、R 重置
- 視野：滑鼠滾輪縮放

## 檔案結構
```
hw1/
  index.html
  assets/
    css/styles.css
    js/car.js          # 3D 場景（可保留或日後移除）
    js/site.js         # 著陸頁動畫與平滑捲動
  README.md
```

## 設計重點
- 溫和明亮色調；車子採鮮紅色，四輪且長>寬。
- 場景物件呼應興趣：咖啡杯、相機、排球、山、書本、雙塔。
- 地面以立體方塊字做「路標」描述專案，具陰影與體積感。
- 無邊界感：位置包裹（wrap），可一直開。

## 顏色原則
- 主色：蛋黃色 (#f3cd75)
- 輔色：黑 / 白。盡量不超過三色；若需多色，以主色為核心，其他為輔助。
- 透過明暗對比與黑白搭配強化層次與可讀性。

## 參考與靈感
- Bruno Simon 的互動作品集（僅作互動靈感）

## 部署
- 直接開啟 `index.html` 或放到任何靜態主機即可。


```

- 已依你提供的版型重設成蛋黃色極簡著陸頁：粗黑字 + 白色膠囊與滑動圓點，並加上 About / Portfolio / Contact 區塊與照片預留位。
- 新增互動：
  - 膠囊內黑點左右滑動動畫與錨點平滑捲動。
  - 保留 3D 場景檔可隨時切換或後續擴充。
- 色彩與排版：
  - 主色為蛋黃 #f3cd75，輔色黑/白，整體層次與對比明確，符合你的配色原則。
- 檔案調整：
  - `index.html`：新落地頁、關於/作品/聯絡區、照片占位。
  - `assets/css/styles.css`：新增 logo 膠囊風格、響應式字級與卡片網格。
  - `assets/js/site.js`：膠囊黑點動畫與平滑捲動。
  - `README.md`：已更新 v3 設計、色彩與操作說明。

const dotTop = document.querySelector<HTMLSpanElement>('.pill-top .dot');
const dotBottom = document.querySelector<HTMLSpanElement>('.pill-bottom .dot');
const hero = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.hero-landing');
const logo = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.logo');

function animateDots(){
  const t = (performance.now()/1000) % 2;
  const p = Math.abs(Math.sin(t*Math.PI));
  if(dotTop){ dotTop.style.left = `${p*100}%`; dotTop.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
  if(dotBottom){ const q = 1-p; dotBottom.style.left = `${q*100}%`; dotBottom.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
  requestAnimationFrame(animateDots);
}

function invertTheme(){
  if(!hero || !logo) return;
  const bg = getComputedStyle(hero).backgroundColor;
  const isYellow = bg !== 'rgb(11, 11, 11)';
  // rule: yellow -> black, black -> white, white -> yellow
  if(isYellow){
    hero.style.backgroundColor = '#0b0b0b';
    logo.style.color = '#ffffff';
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--accent', '#f3cd75');
  }else{
    // currently black; swap black->white, white->yellow
    hero.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
    logo.style.color = '#f3cd75';
  }
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateDots);
  document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    // only left button
    if((e as MouseEvent).button === 0){ invertTheme(); }
  });
});

  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  function tick(){
    const t = (performance.now()/1000)%2;
    const p = Math.abs(Math.sin(t*Math.PI));
    if(dotTop){ dotTop.style.left = `${p*100}%`; dotTop.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    if(dotBottom){ const q = 1-p; dotBottom.style.left = `${q*100}%`; dotBottom.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  // smooth scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>{
    a.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const id = a.getAttribute('href')?.slice(1); if(!id) return;
      const el = document.getElementById(id); if(!el) return;
      e.preventDefault(); el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
    if(e.button !== 0) return;
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    const bg = getComputedStyle(hero).backgroundColor;
    if(bg !== 'rgb(11, 11, 11)'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = '#0b0b0b';
      logo.style.color = '#ffffff';
    }else if(bg === 'rgb(11, 11, 11)'){
      // black -> white stage
      hero.style.backgroundColor = '#ffffff';
      logo.style.color = '#f3cd75';
    }
  });
})();

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  function tick(){
    const t = (performance.now()/1000)%2;
    const p = Math.abs(Math.sin(t*Math.PI));
    if(dotTop){ dotTop.style.left = `${p*100}%`; dotTop.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    if(dotBottom){ const q = 1-p; dotBottom.style.left = `${q*100}%`; dotBottom.style.transform = 'translateX(-50%)'; }
    requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  // smooth scroll
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>{
    a.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
      const id = a.getAttribute('href')?.slice(1); if(!id) return;
      const el = document.getElementById(id); if(!el) return;
      e.preventDefault(); el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'});
    });
  });
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.button===0) advanceTheme(); });

  // auto advance every 3 seconds
  applyTheme();
  setInterval(advanceTheme, 3000);
})();
