```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse X position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 700; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Reverse direction for bottom ball
        const reversedMoveX = -moveX;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, reversedMoveX));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'reversed:', reversedMoveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateBallPositions);
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'Normalized:', mouseX / window.innerWidth);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    const normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseY / windowHeight));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 700; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Reverse direction for bottom ball
        const reversedMoveX = -moveX;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, reversedMoveX));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'reversed:', reversedMoveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateBallPositions);
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'Normalized:', mouseX / window.innerWidth);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

完成！我已經成功修改了下方球體的追蹤方式。

**修改內容：**

## �� 球體追蹤方式：

**上方球體（Top Ball）：**
- ✅ 追蹤滑鼠 **X 軸** 移動
- ✅ 左右移動，跟隨滑鼠水平位置

**下方球體（Bottom Ball）：**
- ✅ 追蹤滑鼠 **Y 軸** 移動
- ✅ 左右移動，但位置對應滑鼠垂直位置
- ✅ 滑鼠在上方時，球體偏左
- ✅ 滑鼠在下方時，球體偏右

## �� 控制台日誌：

現在控制台會顯示：
- `Mouse moved to X: [x] Y: [y]` - 滑鼠的 X 和 Y 座標
- `Normalized X: [x] Y: [y]` - 標準化的座標值（0-1 範圍）
- `Bottom ball - moveY: [y]` - 下方球體的 Y 軸移動計算

## ⚡ 靈敏度：

- **上方球體**：追蹤 X 軸，靈敏度 700 倍
- **下方球體**：追蹤 Y 軸，靈敏度 2.5 倍

**現在的行為：**
- 移動滑鼠左右 → 上方球體跟隨移動
- 移動滑鼠上下 → 下方球體跟隨移動
- 兩個球體各自獨立追蹤不同的滑鼠軸向

現在請重新整理瀏覽器頁面，您會看到上方球體追蹤滑鼠的左右移動，下方球體追蹤滑鼠的上下移動！

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Ball zoom animation
  let ballScale = 1;
  let targetScale = 1;
  const maxScale = 50; // Maximum scale to fill screen
  const zoomSpeed = 0.1; // Animation speed
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    const normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseY / windowHeight));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        
        // Use Y position for bottom ball movement instead of X
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateBallPositions);
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

```javascript
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Ball zoom animation
  let ballScale = 1;
  let targetScale = 1;
  const maxScale = 50; // Maximum scale to fill screen
  const zoomSpeed = 0.1; // Animation speed
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    const normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseY / windowHeight));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        
        // Use Y position for bottom ball movement instead of X
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
```
    
```javascript
    // Update ball scale animation
    ballScale += (targetScale - ballScale) * zoomSpeed;
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateBallPositions);
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
```

```css
:root{
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --fg: #0f172a;
  --muted: #475569;
  --accent: #2563eb;
  --card: #f8fafc;
  --border: #e2e8f0;
}
[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg: #0b1220;
  --fg: #e5e7eb;
  --muted: #94a3b8;
  --accent: #60a5fa;
  --card: #0f172a;
  --border: #1f2937;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{height:100%}
body{
  margin:0;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Noto Sans, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
  color:var(--fg);
  background:var(--bg);
  line-height:1.6;
}
/* Resetted to minimal styles for v2 */
.btn{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--border);padding:10px 16px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--fg);text-decoration:none;background:var(--card);transition:all 0.2s ease}
.btn.primary{background:var(--accent);border-color:var(--accent);color:#fff}
.section{padding:0}

/* Hover effects with color harmony */
.hero-landing:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg, #f3cd75 0%, #e6b800 50%, #d4a017 100%);}
.logo:hover{color:#2c1810;text-shadow:0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);}
.pill:hover{background:#f8f8f8;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);}
.pill .dot.eye:hover{background:#1a1a1a;}
.tagline:hover{color:#2c1810;letter-spacing:4px;}

.content-section:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fff5d6 0%, #fef3c7 100%);}
.content-section.alt:hover{background:linear-gradient(180deg, #fef3c7 0%, #fde68a 100%);}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);background:linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 0%, #f8fafc 100%);}
.card .shot:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg, #e5e7eb 0%, #d1d5db 100%);transform:scale(1.02);}
.photo-placeholder:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg, #e5e7eb 0%, #d1d5db 100%);border-color:#9ca3af;transform:scale(1.02);}

@media (max-width: 800px){
  .nav-toggle{display:inline-block}
  .nav-list{display:none;position:absolute;right:8px;top:56px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;flex-direction:column}
  .nav-list[aria-expanded="true"]{display:flex}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero{padding:56px 0}
}

@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
  :root{color-scheme:dark}
}

/* Landing layout */
.hero-landing{background:#f3cd75;height:100vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;transition:all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1);position:relative}
.logo{font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,100px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:0.9;margin:0;color:#0b0b0b;transition:all 0.3s ease}
.pill{display:inline-flex;vertical-align:middle;position:relative;width:8ch;height:1.8ch;border-radius:999px;background:#fff;margin:0 6px;transition:all 0.2s ease}
.pill .dot{position:absolute;width:1.8ch;height:1.8ch;background:#0b0b0b;border-radius:50%;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%, -50%);transition:all 0.3s ease;transform-origin:center}
.pill .dot.eye{transform:translate(-50%, -50%);}
.pill .dot.closed{height:0.1ch !important;background:#0b0b0b !important;border-radius:0 !important;transform:translate(-50%, -50%) !important;width:1.8ch !important}
.pill-bottom .dot{left:50%;top:50%}
.tagline{display:block;font-size:clamp(14px,1.6vw,18px);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin:16px 0;color:#2c1810;font-weight:400;opacity:0.8;transition:all 0.3s ease}
.tagline:hover{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-2px)}
```

**新增功能：**

## �� 滾輪縮放動畫：

**滾輪向上（往前滾）：**
- ✅ 球體逐漸放大
- ✅ 每次滾動增加 2 倍縮放
- ✅ 最大縮放可達 50 倍（佔滿整個畫面）

**滾輪向下（往後滾）：**
- ✅ 球體逐漸縮小
- ✅ 每次滾動減少 2 倍縮放

- `Zoom out - targetScale: [數值]` - 縮小時

**Cursor**

我來檢查程式碼，找出為什麼滾輪縮放效果沒有正常運作的原因。


我發現問題了！問題在於 `updateBallPositions` 函數只在滑鼠移動時才會被呼叫，但縮放動畫需要在沒有滑鼠移動時也能持續運作。讓我修正這個問題：


```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Ball zoom animation
  let ballScale = 1;
  let targetScale = 1;
  const maxScale = 50; // Maximum scale to fill screen
  const zoomSpeed = 0.1; // Animation speed
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    const normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseY / windowHeight));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        
        // Use Y position for bottom ball movement instead of X
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Update ball scale animation
    ballScale += (targetScale - ballScale) * zoomSpeed;
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateBallPositions);
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Animation loop that runs continuously
  function animate(){
    updateBallPositions();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Wheel handler for zoom animation
  function handleWheel(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if(e.deltaY < 0){
      // Scroll up - zoom in
      targetScale = Math.min(maxScale, targetScale + 2);
      console.log('Zoom in - targetScale:', targetScale);
    } else {
      // Scroll down - zoom out
      targetScale = Math.max(1, targetScale - 2);
      console.log('Zoom out - targetScale:', targetScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  document.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

```javascript
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Animation loop that runs continuously
  function animate(){
    updateBallPositions();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Wheel handler for zoom animation
  function handleWheel(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    
    if(e.deltaY < 0){
      // Scroll up - zoom in
      targetScale = Math.min(maxScale, targetScale + 2);
      console.log('Zoom in - targetScale:', targetScale);
    } else {
      // Scroll down - zoom out
      targetScale = Math.max(1, targetScale - 2);
      console.log('Zoom out - targetScale:', targetScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  document.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
  
  // Start continuous animation loop
  console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
  animate();
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

完成！我找到並修正了問題：

## �� **問題根源：**

**主要問題：** `updateBallPositions` 函數只在滑鼠移動時才會被呼叫，但縮放動畫需要在沒有滑鼠移動時也能持續運作。

**具體問題：**
1. ❌ 縮放動畫邏輯在 `updateBallPositions` 函數內
2. ❌ `updateBallPositions` 只在滑鼠移動時才被呼叫
3. ❌ 當滑鼠靜止時，縮放動畫停止更新

## ✅ **修正方案：**

**1. 建立持續動畫迴圈：**
```javascript
function animate(){
  updateBallPositions();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
```

**2. 移除條件式呼叫：**
- 移除了 `updateBallPositions` 內的 `requestAnimationFrame` 呼叫
- 改為由持續的 `animate` 迴圈來驅動

**3. 啟動持續動畫：**
```javascript
// Start continuous animation loop
console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
animate();
```

## 🎯 **修正後的效果：**

**現在滾輪縮放應該能正常工作：**
- ✅ 滾輪向上：球體平滑放大
- ✅ 滾輪向下：球體平滑縮小
- ✅ 動畫持續運作，不依賴滑鼠移動
- ✅ 縮放動畫流暢，使用 `requestAnimationFrame` 60fps

**請重新整理瀏覽器頁面，然後測試：**
1. 滾動滑鼠滾輪向上，觀察球體逐漸放大
2. 滾動滑鼠滾輪向下，觀察球體逐漸縮小
3. 球體現在應該能夠放大到佔滿整個畫面的程度！

這個修正確保了縮放動畫能夠持續運作，不會因為滑鼠靜止而停止。

```javascript
function animate(){
  updateBallPositions();
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
}
```

```javascript
// Start continuous animation loop
console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
animate();
```

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  // Ball zoom animation
  let ballScale = 1;
  let targetScale = 1;
  const maxScale = 50; // Maximum scale to fill screen
  const zoomSpeed = 0.1; // Animation speed
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 500);
  }, 1000);
  
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    // Calculate movement based on mouse position
    const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
    const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
    // Map mouse position to full range: 0 to windowWidth -> 0 to 1
    const normalizedX = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseX / windowWidth));
    const normalizedY = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, mouseY / windowHeight));
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; // Increased from 1.5 to 2.5
        
        // Use Y position for bottom ball movement instead of X
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Update ball scale animation
    ballScale += (targetScale - ballScale) * zoomSpeed;
    
    // Debug: Log scale changes
    if(Math.abs(ballScale - 1) > 0.1) {
      console.log('Ball scale updated:', ballScale, 'target:', targetScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      eyeClosedTime = 0;
      
      // Close eyes
      if(dotTop) {
        dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Top eye closed, class:', dotTop.className);
      }
      if(dotBottom) {
        dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        console.log('Bottom eye closed, class:', dotBottom.className);
      }
      
      console.log('Eyes closed at time:', Date.now());
    }
    
    if(isBlinking){
      eyeClosedTime += 16;
      if(eyeClosedTime >= 200){ // Keep closed for 200ms
        // Open eyes
        isBlinking = false;
        eyeClosedTime = 0;
        
        if(dotTop) {
          dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Top eye opened, class:', dotTop.className);
        }
        if(dotBottom) {
          dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Bottom eye opened, class:', dotBottom.className);
        }
        
        console.log('Eyes opened at time:', Date.now());
      }
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    console.log('Mouse moved to X:', mouseX, 'Y:', mouseY, 'Window width:', window.innerWidth, 'height:', window.innerHeight, 'Normalized X:', mouseX / window.innerWidth, 'Y:', mouseY / window.innerHeight);
    if(!isMouseOver){
      isMouseOver = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Animation loop that runs continuously
  function animate(){
    updateBallPositions();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Wheel handler for zoom animation
  function handleWheel(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    
    console.log('Wheel event detected, deltaY:', e.deltaY);
    
    if(e.deltaY < 0){
      // Scroll up - zoom in
      targetScale = Math.min(maxScale, targetScale + 2);
      console.log('Zoom in - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    } else {
      // Scroll down - zoom out
      targetScale = Math.max(1, targetScale - 2);
      console.log('Zoom out - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  document.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
  
  // Test function to manually trigger zoom
  function testZoom() {
    targetScale = 5;
    console.log('Test zoom triggered - targetScale set to 5');
  }
  
  // Add test button
  const testButton = document.createElement('button');
  testButton.textContent = 'Test Zoom';
  testButton.style.position = 'fixed';
  testButton.style.top = '10px';
  testButton.style.right = '10px';
  testButton.style.zIndex = '1000';
  testButton.style.padding = '10px';
  testButton.style.backgroundColor = '#0b0b0b';
  testButton.style.color = '#fff';
  testButton.style.border = 'none';
  testButton.style.borderRadius = '5px';
  testButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  testButton.onclick = testZoom;
  document.body.appendChild(testButton);
  
  // Start continuous animation loop
  console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
  animate();
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    }else{
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = EGG;
    }
  }

  function advanceTheme(){
    themeState = themeState === 'yellow' ? 'black' : themeState === 'black' ? 'white' : 'yellow';
    applyTheme();
  }

  // click to advance
  document.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ 
    if(e.button===0) {
      // Check if clicking on a pill (eye container)
      const clickedPill = e.target.closest('.pill');
      if(clickedPill){
        e.preventDefault();
        e.stopPropagation();
        
        // Manual blink trigger
        console.log('Manual blink triggered');
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
        
        // Open after 200ms
        setTimeout(() => {
          if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
          if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
          console.log('Manual blink completed');
        }, 200);
      } else {
        // Regular theme change
        advanceTheme();
      }
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
})();
```

完成！我找到並修正了問題：

## **問題根源：**

**主要問題：** CSS 中的 `transition: all 0.3s ease` 會覆蓋 JavaScript 的 `transform` 變更，導致縮放效果無法正常顯示。

## ✅ **修正方案：**

**1. 修正 CSS 過渡效果：**
```css
/* 之前：會覆蓋 transform 變更 */
transition: all 0.3s ease;

/* 修正後：只過渡特定屬性，不影響 transform */
transition: background-color 0.3s ease, border-radius 0.3s ease, width 0.3s ease, height 0.3s ease;
```

**2. 添加除錯功能：**
- ✅ 增加滾輪事件日誌
- ✅ 增加縮放值日誌
- ✅ 添加測試按鈕

**3. 添加測試按鈕：**
- ✅ 右上角黑色按鈕 "Test Zoom"
- ✅ 點擊可手動觸發縮放測試

```javascript
// Compiled JS from TypeScript (inline for now)
// Simple pill-dot animation and smooth scroll
(function(){
  console.log('Site.js loaded successfully!');
  
  const dotTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top .dot.eye');
  const dotBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom .dot.eye');
  const hero = document.querySelector('.hero-landing');
  const logo = document.querySelector('.logo');
  
  console.log('Elements found:', { 
    dotTop: dotTop ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    dotBottom: dotBottom ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    hero: hero ? 'Found' : 'Not found', 
    logo: logo ? 'Found' : 'Not found' 
  });
  
  if (!dotTop || !dotBottom) {
    console.error('Critical elements not found!');
    console.log('Available pill elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.pill'));
    console.log('Available dot elements:', document.querySelectorAll('.dot'));
  }
  
  const EGG = '#f3cd75';
  const BLACK = '#0b0b0b';
  const WHITE = '#ffffff';
  let themeState = 'yellow'; // 'yellow' | 'black' | 'white'
  
  // Mouse-controlled ball movement
  let mouseX = 0;
  let mouseY = 0;
  let isMouseOver = false;
  
  
  // Eye blinking functionality
  let eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
  let eyeBlinkInterval = 2000; // Blink every 2 seconds
  let eyeClosedTime = 0;
  let isBlinking = false;
  
  // Test blink immediately on load
  setTimeout(() => {
    console.log('Test blink triggered');
    if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
    if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
      console.log('Test blink completed');
    }, 200);
  }, 1000);
  
  // Ball movement function
  function updateBallPositions(){
    if(!isMouseOver) return;
    
    const normalizedX = mouseX / window.innerWidth;
    const normalizedY = mouseY / window.innerHeight;
    
    // Apply movement to top ball
    if(dotTop){
      const pillTop = document.querySelector('.pill-top');
      if(pillTop){
        const pillRect = pillTop.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveX = (normalizedX - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px) scale(${ballScale})`;
      }
    }
    
    // Update ball scale animation
    ballScale += (targetScale - ballScale) * zoomSpeed;
    
    // Debug: Log scale changes
    if(Math.abs(ballScale - 1) > 0.1) {
      console.log('Ball scale updated:', ballScale, 'target:', targetScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      console.log('Starting blink');
      
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    }
    
    if(isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeClosedTime){
      // Stop blinking
      isBlinking = false;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      console.log('Ending blink');
      
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    isMouseOver = true;
    
    if(!window.ballAnimationStarted){
      window.ballAnimationStarted = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Animation loop that runs continuously
  function animate(){
    updateBallPositions();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Wheel handler for zoom animation
  function handleWheel(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    
    console.log('Wheel event detected, deltaY:', e.deltaY);
    
    if(e.deltaY < 0){
      // Scroll up - zoom in
      targetScale = Math.min(maxScale, targetScale + 2);
      console.log('Zoom in - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    } else {
      // Scroll down - zoom out
      targetScale = Math.max(1, targetScale - 2);
      console.log('Zoom out - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Test function to manually trigger zoom
  function testZoom() {
    targetScale = 5;
    console.log('Test zoom triggered - targetScale set to 5');
  }
  
  // Add test button
  const testButton = document.createElement('button');
  testButton.textContent = 'Test Zoom';
  testButton.style.position = 'fixed';
  testButton.style.top = '10px';
  testButton.style.right = '10px';
  testButton.style.zIndex = '1000';
  testButton.style.padding = '10px';
  testButton.style.backgroundColor = '#0b0b0b';
  testButton.style.color = '#fff';
  testButton.style.border = 'none';
  testButton.style.borderRadius = '5px';
  testButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  testButton.onclick = testZoom;
  document.body.appendChild(testButton);
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  document.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
  
  // Start continuous animation loop
  console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
  animate();
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  
  // Theme functions
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    } else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    } else if(themeState === 'white'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }
  }
  
  function advanceTheme(){
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      themeState = 'black';
    } else if(themeState === 'black'){
      themeState = 'white';
    } else {
      themeState = 'yellow';
    }
    applyTheme();
  }
  
  // Click handler for theme switching
  logo.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    console.log('Logo clicked, current theme:', themeState);
    if(e.detail === 2){
      // Double click - manual blink
      console.log('Double click detected - triggering manual blink');
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
        console.log('Manual blink completed');
      }, 200);
    } else {
      // Regular theme change
      advanceTheme();
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
  
  console.log('All initialization completed!');
})();
```

```javascript
        const clampedMoveX = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveX));
        
        console.log('Top ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveX:', moveX, 'clamped:', clampedMoveX);
        dotTop.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveX}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    // Apply movement to bottom ball (opposite direction)
    if(dotBottom){
      const pillBottom = document.querySelector('.pill-bottom');
      if(pillBottom){
        const pillRect = pillBottom.getBoundingClientRect();
        const ballSize = 1.8 * 16; // Convert ch to px (assuming 1ch = 16px)
        
        // Calculate actual pill width and available movement space
        const actualPillWidth = pillRect.width;
        const availableSpace = (actualPillWidth - ballSize) / 2; // Half space on each side
        
        // Increase sensitivity by using a larger multiplier
        const sensitivityMultiplier = 2.5; //
        const moveY = (normalizedY - 0.5) * 2 * availableSpace * sensitivityMultiplier;
        
        // Strict boundary check - ensure ball never exceeds actual pill boundaries
        const clampedMoveY = Math.max(-availableSpace, Math.min(availableSpace, moveY));
        
        console.log('Bottom ball - pillWidth:', actualPillWidth, 'ballSize:', ballSize, 'availableSpace:', availableSpace, 'moveY:', moveY, 'clamped:', clampedMoveY);
        dotBottom.style.transform = `translate(-50%, -50%) translateX(${clampedMoveY}px)`;
      }
    }
    
    // Update ball scale animation
    ballScale += (targetScale - ballScale) * zoomSpeed;
    
    // Debug: Log scale changes
    if(Math.abs(ballScale - 1) > 0.1) {
      console.log('Ball scale updated:', ballScale, 'target:', targetScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Eye blinking function
  function updateEyeBlinking(){
    console.log('Eye blinking function called, timer:', eyeBlinkTimer, 'blinking:', isBlinking);
    eyeBlinkTimer += 16; // Approximate 60fps timing
    
    if(!isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeBlinkInterval){
      // Start blinking
      isBlinking = true;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      console.log('Starting blink');
      
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
    }
    
    if(isBlinking && eyeBlinkTimer >= eyeClosedTime){
      // Stop blinking
      isBlinking = false;
      eyeBlinkTimer = 0;
      console.log('Ending blink');
      
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
    }
    
    requestAnimationFrame(updateEyeBlinking);
  }
  
  // Mouse move handler
  function handleMouseMove(e){
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    isMouseOver = true;
    
    if(!window.ballAnimationStarted){
      window.ballAnimationStarted = true;
      console.log('Starting ball animation');
      updateBallPositions();
    }
  }
  
  // Mouse leave handler
  function handleMouseLeave(){
    isMouseOver = false;
  }
  
  // Animation loop that runs continuously
  function animate(){
    updateBallPositions();
    requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  }
  
  // Wheel handler for zoom animation
  function handleWheel(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    
    console.log('Wheel event detected, deltaY:', e.deltaY);
    
    if(e.deltaY < 0){
      // Scroll up - zoom in
      targetScale = Math.min(maxScale, targetScale + 2);
      console.log('Zoom in - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    } else {
      // Scroll down - zoom out
      targetScale = Math.max(1, targetScale - 2);
      console.log('Zoom out - targetScale:', targetScale, 'ballScale:', ballScale);
    }
  }
  
  // Test function to manually trigger zoom
  function testZoom() {
    targetScale = 5;
    console.log('Test zoom triggered - targetScale set to 5');
  }
  
  // Add test button
  const testButton = document.createElement('button');
  testButton.textContent = 'Test Zoom';
  testButton.style.position = 'fixed';
  testButton.style.top = '10px';
  testButton.style.right = '10px';
  testButton.style.zIndex = '1000';
  testButton.style.padding = '10px';
  testButton.style.backgroundColor = '#0b0b0b';
  testButton.style.color = '#fff';
  testButton.style.border = 'none';
  testButton.style.borderRadius = '5px';
  testButton.style.cursor = 'pointer';
  testButton.onclick = testZoom;
  document.body.appendChild(testButton);
  
  // Add event listeners
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
  document.addEventListener('mouseleave', handleMouseLeave);
  document.addEventListener('wheel', handleWheel, { passive: false });
  
  // Start continuous animation loop
  console.log('Starting continuous animation loop');
  animate();
  
  // Start eye blinking animation
  console.log('Starting eye blinking animation');
  updateEyeBlinking();
  
  // Theme functions
  function applyTheme(){
    if(!hero || !logo) return;
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = EGG;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    } else if(themeState === 'black'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = BLACK;
      logo.style.color = WHITE;
    } else if(themeState === 'white'){
      hero.style.backgroundColor = WHITE;
      logo.style.color = BLACK;
    }
  }
  
  function advanceTheme(){
    if(themeState === 'yellow'){
      themeState = 'black';
    } else if(themeState === 'black'){
      themeState = 'white';
    } else {
      themeState = 'yellow';
    }
    applyTheme();
  }
  
  // Click handler for theme switching
  logo.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    console.log('Logo clicked, current theme:', themeState);
    if(e.detail === 2){
      // Double click - manual blink
      console.log('Double click detected - triggering manual blink');
      if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.add('closed');
      if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.add('closed');
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        if(dotTop) dotTop.classList.remove('closed');
        if(dotBottom) dotBottom.classList.remove('closed');
        console.log('Manual blink completed');
      }, 200);
    } else {
      // Regular theme change
      advanceTheme();
    }
  });

  // Initialize theme
  applyTheme();
  
  console.log('All initialization completed!');
})();
```
