讓我也為最小螢幕添加單欄佈局：


```css
/* Squarespace 風格 - 個人作品集網站 */

/* CSS 重設與基礎樣式 */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    font-size: 16px;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* 容器 */
.container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

/* 導航列 - Squarespace 風格 */
.navbar {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    z-index: 1000;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.nav-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    height: 72px;
}

.nav-logo .logo-text {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #1a1a1a;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.nav-menu {
    display: flex;
    list-style: none;
    gap: 2.5rem;
}

.nav-link {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #4a4a4a;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
}

.nav-link:hover,
.nav-link.active {
    color: #1a1a1a;
}

.nav-link::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -8px;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-link:hover::after,
.nav-link.active::after {
    width: 100%;
}

.nav-toggle {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    cursor: pointer;
    gap: 4px;
}

.bar {
    width: 24px;
    height: 2px;
    background: #1a1a1a;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

/* 主頁區塊 - Modern International Style */
.hero-section {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(15, 15, 35, 0.95) 0%, rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.9) 50%, rgba(22, 33, 62, 0.95) 100%),
                url('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1541961017774-22349e4a1262?ixlib=rb-4.0.3&ixid=M3wxMjA3fDB8MHxwaG90by1wYWdlfHx8fGVufDB8fHx8fA%3D%3D&auto=format&fit=crop&w=1920&q=80') center/cover;
    position: relative;
    padding: 120px 0 80px;
    color: white;
}

.hero-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

.hero-content {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: center;
}

.hero-text {
    max-width: 600px;
}

.hero-title {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.1;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.title-greeting {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #a1a1aa;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
}

.title-name {
    display: block;
    font-size: 5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    color: white;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff, #00d4ff, #ff6b6b);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    background-clip: text;
    text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3));
}

.title-description {
    display: block;
    font-size: 1.75rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #e4e4e7;
    margin-top: 0.5rem;
    font-weight: 300;
}

.hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    color: #a1a1aa;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
    max-width: 550px;
    font-weight: 400;
}

.hero-buttons {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.btn {
    padding: 16px 32px;
    border-radius: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 2px solid transparent;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-primary {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00d4ff, #0099cc);
    color: white;
    border-color: transparent;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
}

.btn-primary:hover {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0099cc, #0077aa);
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.4);
}

.btn-outline {
    background: transparent;
    color: white;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.btn-outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

/* 個人照片區域 */
.hero-visual {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.profile-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 450px;
    height: 450px;
}

.profile-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border-radius: 20px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    box-shadow: 0 30px 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
    border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

.profile-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    filter: contrast(1.1) saturate(1.1);
}

.profile-bg {
    position: absolute;
    top: 30px;
    left: 30px;
    right: -30px;
    bottom: -30px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1), rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1));
    border-radius: 20px;
    opacity: 0.3;
    z-index: 1;
    animation: float 8s ease-in-out infinite;
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

@keyframes float {
    0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px) rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(1deg) scale(1.02); }
}

/* 區塊標題樣式 */

    padding: 12px 16px;
    border: 2px solid #e2e8f0;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
    font-family: inherit;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #6366f1;
}

.form-group textarea {
    resize: vertical;
    min-height: 120px;
}

/* 頁尾 */
.footer {
    background: #1a1a1a;
    color: white;
    padding: 3rem 0;
}

.footer-content {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
}

.footer-text p {
    color: #a1a1aa;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.footer-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.footer-links a {
    color: #a1a1aa;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-links a:hover {
    color: white;
}

/* 響應式設計 */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .hero-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 4rem;
        text-align: center;
    }
    
    .about-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 4rem;
    }
    
    .about-stats {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
        gap: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .contact-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 4rem;
    }
    
    .skills-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .nav-menu {
        position: fixed;
        left: -100%;
        top: 72px;
        flex-direction: column;
        background: white;
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        transition: 0.3s;
        padding: 2rem 0;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    }

    .nav-menu.active {
        left: 0;
    }

    .nav-toggle {
        display: flex;
    }

    .hero-title {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }

    .title-name {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }

    .profile-container {
        width: 320px;
        height: 320px;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
        justify-content: center;
    }

    .btn {
        padding: 14px 28px;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
    }

    .section-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .portfolio-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .footer-content {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        text-align: center;
    }

    .footer-links {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .container {
        padding: 0 16px;
    }
    
    .hero-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .title-name {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }

    .hero-buttons {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .btn {
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 280px;
    }
    
    .about-stats {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 1rem;
    }
}
```

現在創建 CSS 樣式，完全模仿 Squarespace Reseda Fluid Demoji3 模板風格：


```css
/* Squarespace Reseda Fluid Demoji3 Template Style */

/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    font-size: 16px;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333333;
    background-color: #F5F5F0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Container */
.container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

/* Header */
.header {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    z-index: 1000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168, 181, 162, 0.1);
}

.nav-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    height: 80px;
}

.nav-logo .logo-text {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.nav-menu {
    display: flex;
    list-style: none;
    gap: 2.5rem;
}

.nav-link {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #333333;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
}

.nav-link:hover,
.nav-link.active {
    color: #A8B5A2;
}

.nav-link::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -8px;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: #A8B5A2;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-link:hover::after,
.nav-link.active::after {
    width: 100%;
}

.nav-toggle {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    cursor: pointer;
    gap: 4px;
}

.bar {
    width: 24px;
    height: 2px;
    background: #333333;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

/* Hero Section */
.hero-section {
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-background {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: -1;
}

.hero-bg-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    filter: brightness(0.8);
}

.hero-content {
    text-align: center;
    color: white;
    z-index: 2;
    max-width: 800px;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

.hero-title {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.3s forwards;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.6s forwards;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
}

.hero-button {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 16px 32px;
    background: white;
    color: #A8B5A2;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 2px solid #A8B5A2;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.9s forwards;
}

.hero-button:hover {
    background: #A8B5A2;
    color: white;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Section Titles */
.section-title {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

/* About Section */
.about-section {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: #F5F5F0;
}

.about-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 80px;
}

.about-text {
    flex: 1;
}

.about-text .section-title {
    text-align: left;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.about-description {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

.about-image {
    flex: 0 0 400px;
}

.about-photo {
    width: 100%;
    height: 600px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.about-photo:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
}

/* Portfolio Section */
.portfolio-section {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: white;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-item {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

.portfolio-item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

.portfolio-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
}

.portfolio-image {
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
}

.portfolio-image img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 250px;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.portfolio-item:hover .portfolio-image img {
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

.portfolio-content {
    padding: 1.5rem;
}

.portfolio-content h3 {
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.portfolio-content p {
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Contact Section */
.contact-section {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: #F5F5F0;
}

.contact-content {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 80px;
    align-items: start;
}

.contact-info h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.contact-info p {
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

.contact-link {
    display: block;
    color: #A8B5A2;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.contact-link:hover {
    color: #333333;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    background: #A8B5A2;
    color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.social-link:hover {
    background: #333333;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Contact Form */
.contact-form {
    background: white;
    padding: 2rem;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.form-group {
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.form-group label {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

.form-group input,
.form-group textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 16px;
    border: 2px solid #E5E5E5;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-family: inherit;
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
    background: #F5F5F0;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #A8B5A2;
}

.form-group textarea {
    resize: vertical;
    min-height: 120px;
}

.submit-button {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 16px;
    background: #A8B5A2;
    color: white;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.submit-button:hover {
    background: #333333;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Footer */
.footer {
    background: #333333;
    color: white;
    padding: 2rem 0;
}

.footer-content {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
}

.footer-text {
    color: #999;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
}

.footer-social {
    display: flex;
    gap: 1rem;
}

.footer-social-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-social-link:hover {
    background: #A8B5A2;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .about-content {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 3rem;
    }
    
    .about-image {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 400px;
    }
    
    .portfolio-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
    
    .contact-content {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 3rem;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .nav-menu {
        position: fixed;
        left: -100%;
        top: 80px;
        flex-direction: column;
        background: rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.98);
        width: 100%;
        text-align: center;
        transition: 0.3s;
        padding: 2rem 0;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    }

    .nav-menu.active {
        left: 0;
    }

    .nav-toggle {
        display: flex;
    }

    .hero-title {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
    }

    .section-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .about-section,
    .portfolio-section,
    .contact-section {
        padding: 80px 0;
    }

    .portfolio-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }

    .footer-content {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 1rem;
        text-align: center;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .container {
        padding: 0 16px;
    }
    
    .hero-title {
        font-size: 2rem;
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
        font-size: 1.125rem;
    }

    .about-photo {
        height: 400px;
    }

    .contact-form {
        padding: 1.5rem;
    }
}

/* Scroll animations */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    transition: all 0.8s ease;
}

.fade-in.visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
}
```

現在創建 JavaScript 檔案，添加流暢的動畫和互動效果：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Interactive Features
class PortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupNavigation();
        this.setupScrollAnimations();
        this.setupMobileMenu();
        this.setupFormHandling();
        this.setupSmoothScrolling();
        this.setupHeaderScroll();
    }

    // Navigation Setup
    setupNavigation() {
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
        const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');

        // Active navigation on scroll
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            let current = '';
            sections.forEach(section => {
                const sectionTop = section.offsetTop - 100;
                const sectionHeight = section.clientHeight;
                if (scrollY >= sectionTop && scrollY < sectionTop + sectionHeight) {
                    current = section.getAttribute('id');
                }
            });

            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.classList.remove('active');
                if (link.getAttribute('href') === `#${current}`) {
                    link.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Smooth Scrolling
    setupSmoothScrolling() {
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]');
        
        links.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');
                const targetSection = document.querySelector(targetId);
                
                if (targetSection) {
                    const offsetTop = targetSection.offsetTop - 80; // Account for fixed header
                    
                    window.scrollTo({
                        top: offsetTop,
                        behavior: 'smooth'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Mobile Menu Toggle
    setupMobileMenu() {
        const navToggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle');
        const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');

        if (navToggle && navMenu) {
            navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navMenu.classList.toggle('active');
                navToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            });

            // Close menu when clicking on a link
            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                });
            });

            // Close menu when clicking outside
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!navToggle.contains(e.target) && !navMenu.contains(e.target)) {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    setupScrollAnimations() {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe elements for animation
        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item, .about-text, .contact-info');
        animatedElements.forEach(el => {
            el.classList.add('fade-in');
            observer.observe(el);
        });

        // Parallax effect for hero section
        this.setupParallaxEffect();
    }

    // Parallax Effect
    setupParallaxEffect() {
        const heroSection = document.querySelector('.hero-section');
        const heroImage = document.querySelector('.hero-bg-image');
        
        if (heroSection && heroImage) {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
                const rate = scrolled * -0.5;
                
                if (scrolled < heroSection.offsetHeight) {
                    heroImage.style.transform = `translateY(${rate}px)`;
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Header Scroll Effect
    setupHeaderScroll() {
        const header = document.getElementById('header');
        
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 100) {
                header.style.background = 'rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.98)';
                header.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';
            } else {
                header.style.background = 'rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.95)';
                header.style.boxShadow = 'none';
            }
        });
    }

    // Form Handling
    setupFormHandling() {
        const contactForm = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        
        if (contactForm) {
            contactForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                
                // Get form data
                const formData = new FormData(contactForm);
                const name = formData.get('name');
                const email = formData.get('email');
                const message = formData.get('message');
                
                // Simple validation
                if (!name || !email || !message) {
                    this.showNotification('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (!this.isValidEmail(email)) {
                    this.showNotification('Please enter a valid email address', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                
                // Simulate form submission
                this.showNotification('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
                contactForm.reset();
            });
        }
    }

    // Email Validation
    isValidEmail(email) {
        const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
        return emailRegex.test(email);
    }

    // Notification System
    showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
        // Remove existing notifications
        const existingNotification = document.querySelector('.notification');
        if (existingNotification) {
            existingNotification.remove();
        }

        // Create notification element
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = `notification notification-${type}`;
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="notification-content">
                <span class="notification-message">${message}</span>
                <button class="notification-close">&times;</button>
            </div>
        `;

        // Add styles
        notification.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 100px;
            right: 24px;
            background: ${type === 'success' ? '#A8B5A2' : type === 'error' ? '#e74c3c' : '#333333'};
            color: white;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            z-index: 10000;
            transform: translateX(100%);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            max-width: 300px;
        `;

        // Add to page
        document.body.appendChild(notification);

        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
        }, 100);

        // Close button functionality
        const closeBtn = notification.querySelector('.notification-close');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            notification.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
            setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 300);
        });

        // Auto remove after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (notification.parentNode) {
                notification.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
                setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 300);
            }
        }, 5000);
    }

    // Portfolio Item Hover Effects
    setupPortfolioHover() {
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        portfolioItems.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                item.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px) scale(1.02)';
            });
            
            item.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                item.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)';
            });
        });
    }

    // Typing Animation for Hero Title
    setupTypingAnimation() {
        const heroTitle = document.querySelector('.hero-title');
        if (heroTitle) {
            const text = heroTitle.textContent;
            heroTitle.textContent = '';
            
            let i = 0;
            const typeWriter = () => {
                if (i < text.length) {
                    heroTitle.textContent += text.charAt(i);
                    i++;
                    setTimeout(typeWriter, 100);
                }
            };
            
            // Start typing animation after initial fade in
            setTimeout(typeWriter, 1000);
        }
    }

    // Lazy Loading for Images
    setupLazyLoading() {
        const images = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
        
        const imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const img = entry.target;
                    img.src = img.dataset.src;
                    img.classList.remove('lazy');
                    imageObserver.unobserve(img);
                }
            });
        });

        images.forEach(img => imageObserver.observe(img));
    }

    // Performance Optimization
    optimizePerformance() {
        // Throttle scroll events
        let ticking = false;
        
        const updateScrollEffects = () => {
            // Update parallax and header effects here
            ticking = false;
        };

        const requestTick = () => {
            if (!ticking) {
                requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollEffects);
                ticking = true;
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', requestTick);
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new PortfolioApp();
    
    // Add loading animation
    document.body.classList.add('loaded');
    
    // Add some additional CSS for animations
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        .notification-content {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
        }
        
        .notification-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0;
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        
        .notification-close:hover {
            opacity: 0.8;
        }
        
        .loaded .hero-title,
        .loaded .hero-subtitle,
        .loaded .hero-button {
            animation-play-state: running;
        }
        
        .portfolio-item {
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(7px, -6px);
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');
    const navToggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle');
    
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
        navMenu.classList.remove('active');
        navToggle.classList.remove('active');
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = PortfolioApp;
}
```

### **響應式設計**
- **桌面版** (1024px+)：完整佈局
- **平板版** (768px-1024px)：調整為 2 欄佈局
- **手機版** (768px 以下)：單欄佈局，字體縮小

### **互動功能**
- **平滑滾動**：點擊導航自動滾動到對應區塊
- **表單驗證**：聯絡表單完整驗證
- **通知系統**：成功/錯誤訊息顯示
- **行動選單**：響應式漢堡選單

**User**

更新一個純前端主頁設計，基於 Squarespace Reseda Fluid Demoji3 模板風格，現在加入一張佔滿版面的背景圖片。要求如下：

- Hero Section: 全屏高度 (100vh)，使用背景圖片 <img src='@https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/4f6792f624ac778428aca39d/1658250422218-HX2GXCWFY734EW1WM599/D062_Q222_Fluid+Engine_Newsroom+Image_2500X1523.png?format=2500w '> 或 background-image 設置，圖片覆蓋整個視窗 (object-fit: cover 或 background-size: cover)。添加一個半透明黑色遮罩 (rgba(0,0,0,0.4)) 讓文字可讀。
- 內容: 中心疊加白色文字 "Hi, I'm [Daniel Wu" (h1, 大字體, bold)，副標 "Creative Designer & Artist" (h2, 正常大小)，下方按鈕 "Explore My Work" (白色背景，綠邊框 #A8B5A2，hover 時變深綠 #7F937E)。
- 動畫: 英雄區圖片和文字使用 CSS fade-in 動畫 (transition: opacity 0.5s)，頁面載入時從透明淡入。
- 響應式: 手機 (max-width 768px) 時，英雄區高度縮為 50vh，文字和按鈕縮小 (h1 24px, h2 18px)。
- 結構: 使用 semantic HTML (section)，CSS 使用 Flexbox 居中內容。
- 輸出: 完整的 index.html 和 styles.css 代碼，分開文件。

替換 [Daniel Wu] 為你的真實名字。

現在更新 CSS 樣式，實現您要求的所有功能：


```css
/* Squarespace Reseda Fluid Demoji3 Template Style */

/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
    font-size: 16px;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333333;
    background-color: #F5F5F0;
    overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Container */
.container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
}

/* Header */
.header {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    z-index: 1000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(168, 181, 162, 0.1);
}

.nav-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    height: 80px;
}

.nav-logo .logo-text {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.nav-menu {
    display: flex;
    list-style: none;
    gap: 2.5rem;
}

.nav-link {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #333333;
    font-weight: 400;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
}

.nav-link:hover,
.nav-link.active {
    color: #A8B5A2;
}

.nav-link::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -8px;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: #A8B5A2;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-link:hover::after,
.nav-link.active::after {
    width: 100%;
}

.nav-toggle {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    cursor: pointer;
    gap: 4px;
}

.bar {
    width: 24px;
    height: 2px;
    background: #333333;
    transition: 0.3s;
}

/* Hero Section */
.hero-section {
    height: 100vh;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.hero-background {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    z-index: 1;
}

.hero-bg-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}

.hero-bg-image.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

.hero-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    z-index: 2;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}

.hero-overlay.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

.hero-content {
    position: relative;
    text-align: center;
    color: white;
    z-index: 3;
    max-width: 800px;
    padding: 0 24px;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
}

.hero-content.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

.hero-title {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.3s forwards;
}

.hero-subtitle {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
    color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.6s forwards;
}

.hero-button {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 16px 32px;
    background: white;
    color: #A8B5A2;
    text-decoration: none;
    border: 2px solid #A8B5A2;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 1rem;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 1s ease 0.9s forwards;
}

.hero-button:hover {
    background: #7F937E;
    color: white;
    border-color: #7F937E;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
}

/* Animations */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Section Titles */
.section-title {
    font-size: 2.5rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
    text-align: center;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

/* About Section */
.about-section {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: #F5F5F0;
}

.about-content {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 80px;
}

.about-text {
    flex: 1;
}

.about-text .section-title {
    text-align: left;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.about-description {
    font-size: 1.125rem;
    color: #333333;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    line-height: 1.7;
}

.about-image {
    flex: 0 0 400px;
}

.about-photo {
    width: 100%;
    height: 600px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.about-photo:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
}

/* Portfolio Section */
.portfolio-section {
    padding: 120px 0;
    background: white;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-item {
    background: white;
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

.portfolio-item:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.1s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.3s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.portfolio-item:nth-child(6) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

}
```

現在更新 JavaScript 檔案，添加圖片載入和淡入動畫功能：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Interactive Features
class PortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupHeroAnimations();
        this.setupNavigation();
        this.setupScrollAnimations();
        this.setupMobileMenu();
        this.setupFormHandling();
        this.setupSmoothScrolling();
        this.setupHeaderScroll();
    }

    // Navigation Setup
    setupNavigation() {
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
        const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');

        // Active navigation on scroll
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            let current = '';
            sections.forEach(section => {
                const sectionTop = section.offsetTop - 100;
                const sectionHeight = section.clientHeight;
                if (scrollY >= sectionTop && scrollY < sectionTop + sectionHeight) {
                    current = section.getAttribute('id');
                }
            });

            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.classList.remove('active');
                if (link.getAttribute('href') === `#${current}`) {
                    link.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Smooth Scrolling
    setupSmoothScrolling() {
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]');
        
        links.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');
                const targetSection = document.querySelector(targetId);
                
                if (targetSection) {
                    const offsetTop = targetSection.offsetTop - 80; // Account for fixed header
                    
                    window.scrollTo({
                        top: offsetTop,
                        behavior: 'smooth'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Mobile Menu Toggle
    setupMobileMenu() {
        const navToggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle');
        const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');

        if (navToggle && navMenu) {
            navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navMenu.classList.toggle('active');
                navToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            });

            // Close menu when clicking on a link
            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                });
            });

            // Close menu when clicking outside
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!navToggle.contains(e.target) && !navMenu.contains(e.target)) {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    setupScrollAnimations() {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe elements for animation
        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item, .about-text, .contact-info');
        animatedElements.forEach(el => {
            el.classList.add('fade-in');
            observer.observe(el);
        });

        // Parallax effect for hero section
        this.setupParallaxEffect();
    }

    // Parallax Effect
    setupParallaxEffect() {
        const heroSection = document.querySelector('.hero-section');
        const heroImage = document.querySelector('.hero-bg-image');
        
        if (heroSection && heroImage) {
            window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
                const scrolled = window.pageYOffset;
                const rate = scrolled * -0.5;
                
                if (scrolled < heroSection.offsetHeight) {
                    heroImage.style.transform = `translateY(${rate}px)`;
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Header Scroll Effect
    setupHeaderScroll() {
        const header = document.getElementById('header');
        
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            if (window.scrollY > 100) {
                header.style.background = 'rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.98)';
                header.style.boxShadow = '0 2px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)';
            } else {
                header.style.background = 'rgba(245, 245, 240, 0.95)';
                header.style.boxShadow = 'none';
            }
        });
    }

    // Form Handling
    setupFormHandling() {
        const contactForm = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        
        if (contactForm) {
            contactForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                
                // Get form data
                const formData = new FormData(contactForm);
                const name = formData.get('name');
                const email = formData.get('email');
                const message = formData.get('message');
                
                // Simple validation
                if (!name || !email || !message) {
                    this.showNotification('Please fill in all fields', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (!this.isValidEmail(email)) {
                    this.showNotification('Please enter a valid email address', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                
                // Simulate form submission
                this.showNotification('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
                contactForm.reset();
            });
        }
    }

    // Email Validation
    isValidEmail(email) {
        const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
        return emailRegex.test(email);
    }

    // Notification System
    showNotification(message, type = 'info') {
        // Remove existing notifications
        const existingNotification = document.querySelector('.notification');
        if (existingNotification) {
            existingNotification.remove();
        }

        // Create notification element
        const notification = document.createElement('div');
        notification.className = `notification notification-${type}`;
        notification.innerHTML = `
            <div class="notification-content">
                <span class="notification-message">${message}</span>
                <button class="notification-close">&times;</button>
            </div>
        `;

        // Add styles
        notification.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 100px;
            right: 24px;
            background: ${type === 'success' ? '#A8B5A2' : type === 'error' ? '#e74c3c' : '#333333'};
            color: white;
            padding: 1rem 1.5rem;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
            z-index: 10000;
            transform: translateX(100%);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            max-width: 300px;
        `;

        // Add to page
        document.body.appendChild(notification);

        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            notification.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
        }, 100);

        // Close button functionality
        const closeBtn = notification.querySelector('.notification-close');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            notification.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
            setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 300);
        });

        // Auto remove after 5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (notification.parentNode) {
                notification.style.transform = 'translateX(100%)';
                setTimeout(() => notification.remove(), 300);
            }
        }, 5000);
    }

    // Portfolio Item Hover Effects
    setupPortfolioHover() {
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        portfolioItems.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                item.style.transform = 'translateY(-8px) scale(1.02)';
            });
            
            item.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                item.style.transform = 'translateY(0) scale(1)';
            });
        });
    }

    // Typing Animation for Hero Title
    setupTypingAnimation() {
        const heroTitle = document.querySelector('.hero-title');
        if (heroTitle) {
            const text = heroTitle.textContent;
            heroTitle.textContent = '';
            
            let i = 0;
            const typeWriter = () => {
                if (i < text.length) {
                    heroTitle.textContent += text.charAt(i);
                    i++;
                    setTimeout(typeWriter, 100);
                }
            };
            
            // Start typing animation after initial fade in
            setTimeout(typeWriter, 1000);
        }
    }

    // Lazy Loading for Images
    setupLazyLoading() {
        const images = document.querySelectorAll('img[data-src]');
        
        const imageObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    const img = entry.target;
                    img.src = img.dataset.src;
                    img.classList.remove('lazy');
                    imageObserver.unobserve(img);
                }
            });
        });

        images.forEach(img => imageObserver.observe(img));
    }

    // Performance Optimization
    optimizePerformance() {
        // Throttle scroll events
        let ticking = false;
        
        const updateScrollEffects = () => {
            // Update parallax and header effects here
            ticking = false;
        };

        const requestTick = () => {
            if (!ticking) {
                requestAnimationFrame(updateScrollEffects);
                ticking = true;
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', requestTick);
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new PortfolioApp();
    
    // Add loading animation
    document.body.classList.add('loaded');
    
    // Add some additional CSS for animations
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = `
        .notification-content {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 1rem;
        }
        
        .notification-close {
            background: none;
            border: none;
            color: white;
            font-size: 1.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            padding: 0;
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        
        .notification-close:hover {
            opacity: 0.8;
        }
        
        .loaded .hero-title,
        .loaded .hero-subtitle,
        .loaded .hero-button {
            animation-play-state: running;
        }
        
        .portfolio-item {
            transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(1) {
            transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(2) {
            opacity: 0;
        }
        
        .nav-toggle.active .bar:nth-child(3) {
            transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(7px, -6px);
        }
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(style);
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const navMenu = document.getElementById('nav-menu');
    const navToggle = document.getElementById('nav-toggle');
    
    if (window.innerWidth > 768) {
        navMenu.classList.remove('active');
        navToggle.classList.remove('active');
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = PortfolioApp;
}
```

```javascript
class PortfolioApp {

    }

    // Hero Animations Setup
    setupHeroAnimations() {
        const heroImage = document.querySelector('.hero-bg-image');
        const heroOverlay = document.querySelector('.hero-overlay');
        const heroContent = document.querySelector('.hero-content');

        if (heroImage) {
            // Wait for image to load
            heroImage.addEventListener('load', () => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    heroImage.classList.add('loaded');
                    if (heroOverlay) heroOverlay.classList.add('loaded');
                    if (heroContent) heroContent.classList.add('loaded');
                }, 100);
            });

            // Fallback if image is already loaded
            if (heroImage.complete) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    heroImage.classList.add('loaded');
                    if (heroOverlay) heroOverlay.classList.add('loaded');
                    if (heroContent) heroContent.classList.add('loaded');
                }, 100);
            }
        }
    }

    // Navigation Setup
    setupNavigation() {
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
        const sections = document.querySelectorAll('section[id]');

        // Active navigation on scroll
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            let current = '';
            sections.forEach(section => {
                const sectionTop = section.offsetTop - 100;
                const sectionHeight = section.clientHeight;
                if (scrollY >= sectionTop && scrollY < sectionTop + sectionHeight) {
                    current = section.getAttribute('id');
                }
            });

            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.classList.remove('active');
                if (link.getAttribute('href') === `#${current}`) {
                    link.classList.add('active');
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Smooth Scrolling
    setupSmoothScrolling() {
        const links = document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]');
        
        links.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');
                const targetSection = document.querySelector(targetId);
                
                if (targetSection) {
                    const offsetTop = targetSection.offsetTop - 80; // Account for fixed header
                    
                    window.scrollTo({
                        top: offsetTop,
                        behavior: 'smooth'
                    });
                }
            });
        });
    }

            navToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                navMenu.classList.toggle('active');
                navToggle.classList.toggle('active');
            });

            // Close menu when clicking on a link
            navLinks.forEach(link => {
                link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                });
            });

            // Close menu when clicking outside
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!navToggle.contains(e.target) && !navMenu.contains(e.target)) {
                    navMenu.classList.remove('active');
                    navToggle.classList.remove('active');
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    setupScrollAnimations() {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                }

        // Observe elements for animation

        animatedElements.forEach(el => {
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
```

```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #F5E6D3; /* Light orange/tan background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    padding: 2rem;
}

/* Name Section */
.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 4rem;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    color: #000;
    line-height: 0.8;
}

/* Toggle Circle */
.toggle-circle {
    width: 120px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #fff;
    border-radius: 30px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 6px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.circle {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    position: absolute;
    left: 6px;
}

.circle.active {
    transform: translateX(60px);
}

/* Marquee Container */
.marquee-container {
    width: 100%;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 2rem 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 20s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Marquee Animation */
@keyframes marquee {
    0% {
        transform: translateX(100%);
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateX(-100%);
    }
}

/* Navigation */
.navigation {
    position: fixed;
    top: 2rem;
    right: 2rem;
    z-index: 100;
}

.nav-links {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.nav-link {
    color: #000;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    position: relative;
}

.nav-link::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -4px;
    left: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 2px;
    background: #000;
    transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-link:hover::after {
    width: 100%;
}

/* Cursor Follower */
.cursor-follower {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
    mix-blend-mode: difference;
}

/* Hover Effects */
.name-part:hover {
    color: #666;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.toggle-circle:hover .circle {
    transform: translateX(30px);
}

.toggle-circle:hover .circle.active {
    transform: translateX(60px);
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .toggle-circle {
        width: 100px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .circle {
        width: 38px;
        height: 38px;
    }
    
    .circle.active {
        transform: translateX(50px);
    }
    
    .toggle-circle:hover .circle.active {
        transform: translateX(50px);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .main-container {
        padding: 1rem;
    }
    
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 0.5rem;
    }
    
    .toggle-circle {
        width: 80px;
        height: 40px;
    }
    
    .circle {
        width: 28px;
        height: 28px;
    }
    
    .circle.active {
        transform: translateX(40px);
    }
    
    .marquee-container {
        height: 50px;
        margin: 1.5rem 0;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        padding: 0 1rem;
    }
    
    .navigation {
        top: 1rem;
        right: 1rem;
    }
    
    .nav-links {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .nav-link {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cursor-follower {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .toggle-circle {
        width: 60px;
        height: 30px;
    }
    
    .circle {
        width: 18px;
        height: 18px;
    }
    
    .circle.active {
        transform: translateX(30px);
    }
    
    .marquee-container {
        height: 40px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.7rem;
    }
    
    .nav-links {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.5rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .circle {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}
```

現在創建 JavaScript 檔案，添加互動功能：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Interactive Features
class PortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupCursorFollower();
        this.setupToggleAnimations();
        this.setupSmoothScrolling();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
        this.setupMarqueeControl();
    }

    // Custom Cursor Follower
    setupCursorFollower() {
        const cursor = document.querySelector('.cursor-follower');
        
        if (cursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                cursor.style.left = e.clientX - 10 + 'px';
                cursor.style.top = e.clientY - 10 + 'px';
            });

            // Hide cursor when hovering over interactive elements
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .toggle-circle');
            interactiveElements.forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    cursor.style.transform = 'scale(1.5)';
                    cursor.style.background = '#666';
                });
                
                el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    cursor.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                    cursor.style.background = '#000';
                });
            });
        }
    }

    // Toggle Circle Animations
    setupToggleAnimations() {
        const toggleCircles = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-circle');
        
        toggleCircles.forEach((toggle, index) => {
            toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
                const circle = toggle.querySelector('.circle');
                circle.classList.toggle('active');
                
                // Add ripple effect
                this.createRippleEffect(toggle);
            });

            // Random animation on page load
            setTimeout(() => {
                const circle = toggle.querySelector('.circle');
                if (Math.random() > 0.5) {
                    circle.classList.add('active');
                }
            }, 1000 + (index * 500));
        });
    }

    // Ripple Effect
    createRippleEffect(element) {
        const ripple = document.createElement('div');
        ripple.style.cssText = `
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            transform: scale(0);
            animation: ripple 0.6s linear;
            pointer-events: none;
            width: 100px;
            height: 100px;
            left: 50%;
            top: 50%;
            margin-left: -50px;
            margin-top: -50px;
        `;

        // Add ripple animation CSS if not exists
        if (!document.querySelector('#ripple-animation')) {
            const style = document.createElement('style');
            style.id = 'ripple-animation';
            style.textContent = `
                @keyframes ripple {
                    to {
                        transform: scale(4);
                        opacity: 0;
                    }
                }
            `;
            document.head.appendChild(style);
        }

        element.style.position = 'relative';
        element.appendChild(ripple);

        setTimeout(() => {
            ripple.remove();
        }, 600);
    }

    // Smooth Scrolling
    setupSmoothScrolling() {
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
        
        navLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = link.getAttribute('href');
                
                if (targetId.startsWith('#')) {
                    const targetElement = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (targetElement) {
                        targetElement.scrollIntoView({
                            behavior: 'smooth',
                            block: 'start'
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    setupLoadingAnimation() {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            const marqueeContainer = document.querySelector('.marquee-container');
            const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link');
            
            // Staggered fade-in animation
            nameParts.forEach((part, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    part.classList.add('fade-in');
                }, index * 200);
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                if (marqueeContainer) {
                    marqueeContainer.classList.add('fade-in');
                }
            }, 800);

            navLinks.forEach((link, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    link.classList.add('fade-in');
                }, 1000 + (index * 100));
            });

            // Add loaded class to body
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Marquee Control
    setupMarqueeControl() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        
        if (marqueeContent) {
            // Pause on hover
            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
            });

            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
            });

            // Speed control based on window size
            this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            });
        }
    }

    // Update Marquee Speed
    updateMarqueeSpeed() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        if (marqueeContent) {
            const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let duration;
            
            if (windowWidth < 480) {
                duration = '15s';
            } else if (windowWidth < 768) {
                duration = '18s';
            } else {
                duration = '20s';
            }
            
            marqueeContent.style.animationDuration = duration;
        }
    }

    // Random Name Animation
    animateNameParts() {
        const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
        
        setInterval(() => {
            const randomPart = nameParts[Math.floor(Math.random() * nameParts.length)];
            randomPart.style.transform = 'scale(1.05)';
            randomPart.style.color = '#666';
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                randomPart.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
                randomPart.style.color = '#000';
            }, 200);
        }, 3000);
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    setupKeyboardNavigation() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            const toggleCircles = document.querySelectorAll('.toggle-circle');
            
            if (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter') {
                e.preventDefault();
                const randomToggle = toggleCircles[Math.floor(Math.random() * toggleCircles.length)];
                randomToggle.click();
            }
        });
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    },

    // Generate random color
    randomColor() {
        const colors = ['#000', '#666', '#999', '#ccc'];
        return colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)];
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new PortfolioApp();
    
    // Add some additional interactive features
    setTimeout(() => {
        app.animateNameParts();
        app.setupKeyboardNavigation();
    }, 2000);
    
    // Add loading state management
    document.body.classList.add('loading');
    
    // Performance optimization
    window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
        app.updateMarqueeSpeed();
    }, 250));
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const cursor = document.querySelector('.cursor-follower');
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && cursor) {
        cursor.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (cursor) {
        cursor.style.display = 'block';
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = PortfolioApp;
}
```
