現在更新 JavaScript，實現所有新功能：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features
class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.currentPage = 'hero';
        this.currentColorIndex = 0;
        this.colorSequence = ['black', 'white', 'orange'];
        this.isBlinking = false;
        this.blinkTimers = [];
        this.expandedSection = null;
        
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupCatCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupColorChanges();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupNavItemExpansion();
        this.setupMouseEnterEffects();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
        this.setupMarqueeControl();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
    }

    // Cat Paw Cursor
    setupCatCursor() {
        const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
        
        if (catCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                catCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                catCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Change cursor on hover
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.5)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#FFA500';
                });
                
                el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#000';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };
            mediaQuery.addListener(handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations with Both Eyes Moving
    setupEyeAnimations() {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye, index) => {
            // Both eyes blink independently
            const blinkInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (!this.isBlinking) {
                    this.blinkEye(eye);
                }
            }, 3000 + (index * 1000)); // 1 second delay between eyes
            
            this.blinkTimers.push(blinkInterval);
        });
    }

    // Blink Eye Function with Dynamic Eyelid Color
    blinkEye(eye) {
        const eyelidTop = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-top');
        const eyelidBottom = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-bottom');
        const eyeball = eye.querySelector('.eyeball');
        
        this.isBlinking = true;
        
        // Update eyelid color based on current theme
        const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        eyelidTop.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidBottom.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidTop.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        eyelidBottom.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        
        // Close eyelids
        eyelidTop.classList.add('blinking');
        eyelidBottom.classList.add('blinking');
        
        // Change eyeball color to yellow during blink
        eyeball.style.background = '#FFE135';
        
        // Reopen after 0.5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            eyelidTop.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyelidBottom.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyeball.style.background = '#fff';
            this.isBlinking = false;
        }, 500);
    }

    // Color Changes Every 3 Seconds
    setupColorChanges() {
        setInterval(() => {
            this.changeColorTheme();
        }, 3000);
        
        // Initial color change
        this.changeColorTheme();
    }

    // Change Color Theme
    changeColorTheme() {
        const colorClass = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        
        // Remove all color classes
        document.body.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        
        // Add new color class
        document.body.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        
        // Update current page background
        this.updatePageBackground(colorClass);
        
        // Update eyelid colors for all eyes
        this.updateEyelidColors(colorClass);
        
        // Move to next color
        this.currentColorIndex = (this.currentColorIndex + 1) % this.colorSequence.length;
    }

    // Update Eyelid Colors
    updateEyelidColors(colorClass) {
        const eyelids = document.querySelectorAll('.eyelid-top, .eyelid-bottom');
        eyelids.forEach(eyelid => {
            eyelid.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            eyelid.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        });
    }

    // Update Page Background
    updatePageBackground(colorClass) {
        const activePage = document.querySelector('.page-section.active');
        if (activePage) {
            activePage.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            activePage.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        }
    }

    // Page Navigation
    setupPageNavigation() {
        // Scroll detection for page switching
        let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
        
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
            const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
            
            // Determine current page based on scroll position
            if (currentScrollY < windowHeight / 2) {
                this.switchToPage('hero');
            } else {
                this.switchToPage('navigation');
            }
            
            lastScrollY = currentScrollY;
        });
    }

    // Switch Page
    switchToPage(pageName) {
        if (this.currentPage !== pageName) {
            this.currentPage = pageName;
            
            // Update active page
            document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(section => {
                section.classList.remove('active');
            });
            
            const targetPage = document.querySelector(`#${pageName}`);
            if (targetPage) {
                targetPage.classList.add('active');
                
                // Update background color based on current theme
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                targetPage.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
            }
        }
    }

    // Navigation Item Expansion
    setupNavItemExpansion() {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        
        navItems.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const section = item.dataset.section;
                
                if (this.expandedSection === section) {
                    // Collapse if already expanded
                    this.collapseSection();
                } else {
                    // Expand new section
                    this.expandSection(section);
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Click outside to close
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
                this.collapseSection();
            }
        });
    }

    // Expand Section
    expandSection(sectionName) {
        // Collapse any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        
        const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${sectionName}"]`);
        if (navItem) {
            navItem.classList.add('expanded');
            this.expandedSection = sectionName;
        }
    }

    // Collapse Section
    collapseSection() {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${this.expandedSection}"]`);
            if (navItem) {
                navItem.classList.remove('expanded');
            }
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    // Mouse Enter Effects
    setupMouseEnterEffects() {
        const pageSections = document.querySelectorAll('.page-section');
        
        pageSections.forEach(section => {
            section.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                // Change current page background to contrast color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                let contrastColor;
                
                switch(currentColor) {
                    case 'black':
                        contrastColor = 'white';
                        break;
                    case 'white':
                        contrastColor = 'black';
                        break;
                    case 'orange':
                        contrastColor = 'gray';
                        break;
                }
                
                // Apply contrast background
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(contrastColor);
                
                // Reset other pages to default
                pageSections.forEach(otherSection => {
                    if (otherSection !== section) {
                        otherSection.style.background = '#FFE135';
                    }
                });
            });
            
            section.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                // Reset to current theme color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(currentColor);
            });
        });
    }

    // Get Color Value
    getColorValue(colorName) {
        switch(colorName) {
            case 'black': return '#000';
            case 'white': return '#fff';
            case 'orange': return '#FFA500';
            case 'gray': return '#666';
            default: return '#FFE135';
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Category Interactions
    setupPortfolioInteractions() {
        const portfolioCategories = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-category');
        
        portfolioCategories.forEach(category => {
            category.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const categoryName = category.dataset.category;
                this.showCategoryDetails(categoryName);
            });
        });
    }

    // Show Category Details
    showCategoryDetails(category) {
        // Create modal for category details
        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'category-modal';
        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h2>${category.toUpperCase()}</h2>
                    <button class="close-modal">&times;</button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <p>This is the ${category} section. Here you can add detailed content about your ${category} experiences and projects.</p>
                    <div class="modal-image">
                        <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/400x300/F5E6D3/333333?text=${category.toUpperCase()}" alt="${category}">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        // Style the modal
        modal.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 10000;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        `;
        
        const modalContent = modal.querySelector('.modal-content');
        modalContent.style.cssText = `
            background: #FFE135;
            padding: 2rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 90%;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transform: scale(0.8);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            border: 3px solid #000;
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            modal.style.opacity = '1';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
        }, 100);
        
        // Close modal functionality
        const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.close-modal');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            modal.style.opacity = '0';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (modal.parentNode) {
                    modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                }
            }, 300);
        });
        
        modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) {
                modal.style.opacity = '0';
                modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (modal.parentNode) {
                        modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    setupLoadingAnimation() {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
            
            // Staggered fade-in animation
            nameParts.forEach((part, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    part.classList.add('fade-in');
                }, index * 200);
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                navItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        item.classList.add('fade-in');
                    }, index * 300);
                });
            }, 1000);

            // Add loaded class to body
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Marquee Control
    setupMarqueeControl() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        
        if (marqueeContent) {
            // Pause on hover
            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
            });

            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
            });

            // Speed control based on window size
            this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            });
        }
    }

    // Update Marquee Speed
    updateMarqueeSpeed() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        if (marqueeContent) {
            const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let duration;
            
            if (windowWidth < 480) {
                duration = '15s';
            } else if (windowWidth < 768) {
                duration = '18s';
            } else {
                duration = '20s';
            }
            
            marqueeContent.style.animationDuration = duration;
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    setupKeyboardNavigation() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                // Close any open sections
                this.collapseSection();
                
                // Close any open modals
                const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.category-modal');
                modals.forEach(modal => {
                    modal.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (modal.parentNode) {
                            modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                        }
                    }, 300);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // Cleanup
    destroy() {
        // Clear blinking timers
        this.blinkTimers.forEach(timer => {
            clearInterval(timer);
        });
        
        // Remove event listeners
        document.removeEventListener('click', this.collapseSection);
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
    
    // Add portfolio interactions setup
    setTimeout(() => {
        app.setupPortfolioInteractions();
    }, 1000);
    
    // Add loading state management
    document.body.classList.add('loading');
    
    // Performance optimization
    window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
        app.updateMarqueeSpeed();
    }, 250));
    
    // Cleanup on page unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
        app.destroy();
    });
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'block';
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = AdvancedPortfolioApp;
}
```

```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 200vh; /* 2 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid transparent; /* Transparent border initially */
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eyeball border colors based on page theme */
.eyeball.color-black {
    border-color: #000;
}

.eyeball.color-white {
    border-color: #fff;
}

.eyeball.color-orange {
    border-color: #FFA500;
}

.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Eyelid colors based on page theme */
.eyelid-top.color-black,
.eyelid-bottom.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.eyelid-top.color-white,
.eyelid-bottom.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.eyelid-top.color-orange,
.eyelid-bottom.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Default color */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 4rem 2rem;
    gap: 3rem;
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 6rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    justify-content: center;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    height: 120px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Banner */
.marquee-banner {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: #000;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 15px 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: nowrap;
    z-index: 10;
}

.marquee-content {
    display: inline-block;
    animation: marquee 20s linear infinite;
    padding-left: 100%;
}

.marquee-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-right: 50px;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(0%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {

}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {

}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {

    height: 0;

}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {

}

.circle-text {

}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {

.circle-text p {

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {

}

.portfolio-grid {

    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;

.portfolio-category:hover {

}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;

.portfolio-category p {

.portfolio-category .category-image {

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {

    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {

}

.contact-content {

}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;

}

.social-links {
    display: flex;

    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -5px;
    left: 5px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -5px;
    right: 5px;
}

.paw-print::after::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: 15px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {

}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {

}

.loaded {

}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {

    }
    
    .eyelid-top,

}

/* Scrollbar Styling */

```

現在更新 JavaScript，讓眼球邊框顏色跟隨頁面主題變化：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features
class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.currentPage = 'hero';
        this.currentColorIndex = 0;
        this.colorSequence = ['black', 'white', 'orange'];
        this.isBlinking = false;
        this.blinkTimers = [];
        this.expandedSection = null;
        
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupCatCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupColorChanges();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupNavItemExpansion();
        this.setupMouseEnterEffects();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
        this.setupMarqueeControl();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
    }

    // Cat Paw Cursor
    setupCatCursor() {
        const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
        
        if (catCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                catCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                catCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Change cursor on hover
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.5)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#FFA500';
                });
                
                el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#000';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };
            mediaQuery.addListener(handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations with Both Eyes Moving
    setupEyeAnimations() {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye, index) => {
            // Both eyes blink independently
            const blinkInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (!this.isBlinking) {
                    this.blinkEye(eye);
                }
            }, 3000 + (index * 1000)); // 1 second delay between eyes
            
            this.blinkTimers.push(blinkInterval);
        });
    }

    // Blink Eye Function with Dynamic Eyelid Color
    blinkEye(eye) {
        const eyelidTop = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-top');
        const eyelidBottom = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-bottom');
        const eyeball = eye.querySelector('.eyeball');
        
        this.isBlinking = true;
        
        // Update eyelid color based on current theme
        const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        eyelidTop.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidBottom.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidTop.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        eyelidBottom.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        
        // Close eyelids
        eyelidTop.classList.add('blinking');
        eyelidBottom.classList.add('blinking');
        
        // Change eyeball color to yellow during blink
        eyeball.style.background = '#FFE135';
        
        // Reopen after 0.5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            eyelidTop.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyelidBottom.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyeball.style.background = '#fff';
            this.isBlinking = false;
        }, 500);
    }

    // Color Changes Every 3 Seconds
    setupColorChanges() {
        setInterval(() => {
            this.changeColorTheme();
        }, 3000);
        
        // Initial color change
        this.changeColorTheme();
    }

    // Change Color Theme
    changeColorTheme() {
        const colorClass = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        
        // Remove all color classes
        document.body.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        
        // Add new color class
        document.body.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        
        // Update current page background
        this.updatePageBackground(colorClass);
        
        // Update eyelid colors for all eyes
        this.updateEyelidColors(colorClass);
        
        // Move to next color
        this.currentColorIndex = (this.currentColorIndex + 1) % this.colorSequence.length;
    }

    // Update Eyelid Colors
    updateEyelidColors(colorClass) {
        const eyelids = document.querySelectorAll('.eyelid-top, .eyelid-bottom');
        eyelids.forEach(eyelid => {
            eyelid.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            eyelid.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        });
        
        // Update eyeball border colors
        const eyeballs = document.querySelectorAll('.eyeball');
        eyeballs.forEach(eyeball => {
            eyeball.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            eyeball.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        });
    }

    // Update Page Background
    updatePageBackground(colorClass) {
        const activePage = document.querySelector('.page-section.active');
        if (activePage) {
            activePage.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            activePage.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        }
    }

    // Page Navigation
    setupPageNavigation() {
        // Scroll detection for page switching
        let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
        
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
            const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
            
            // Determine current page based on scroll position
            if (currentScrollY < windowHeight / 2) {
                this.switchToPage('hero');
            } else {
                this.switchToPage('navigation');
            }
            
            lastScrollY = currentScrollY;
        });
    }

    // Switch Page
    switchToPage(pageName) {
        if (this.currentPage !== pageName) {
            this.currentPage = pageName;
            
            // Update active page
            document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(section => {
                section.classList.remove('active');
            });
            
            const targetPage = document.querySelector(`#${pageName}`);
            if (targetPage) {
                targetPage.classList.add('active');
                
                // Update background color based on current theme
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                targetPage.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
            }
        }
    }

    // Navigation Item Expansion
    setupNavItemExpansion() {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        
        navItems.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const section = item.dataset.section;
                
                if (this.expandedSection === section) {
                    // Collapse if already expanded
                    this.collapseSection();
                } else {
                    // Expand new section
                    this.expandSection(section);
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Click outside to close
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
                this.collapseSection();
            }
        });
    }

    // Expand Section
    expandSection(sectionName) {
        // Collapse any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        
        const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${sectionName}"]`);
        if (navItem) {
            navItem.classList.add('expanded');
            this.expandedSection = sectionName;
        }
    }

    // Collapse Section
    collapseSection() {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${this.expandedSection}"]`);
            if (navItem) {
                navItem.classList.remove('expanded');
            }
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    // Mouse Enter Effects
    setupMouseEnterEffects() {
        const pageSections = document.querySelectorAll('.page-section');
        
        pageSections.forEach(section => {
            section.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                // Change current page background to contrast color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                let contrastColor;
                
                switch(currentColor) {
                    case 'black':
                        contrastColor = 'white';
                        break;
                    case 'white':
                        contrastColor = 'black';
                        break;
                    case 'orange':
                        contrastColor = 'gray';
                        break;
                }
                
                // Apply contrast background
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(contrastColor);
                
                // Reset other pages to default
                pageSections.forEach(otherSection => {
                    if (otherSection !== section) {
                        otherSection.style.background = '#FFE135';
                    }
                });
            });
            
            section.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                // Reset to current theme color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(currentColor);
            });
        });
    }

    // Get Color Value
    getColorValue(colorName) {
        switch(colorName) {
            case 'black': return '#000';
            case 'white': return '#fff';
            case 'orange': return '#FFA500';
            case 'gray': return '#666';
            default: return '#FFE135';
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Category Interactions
    setupPortfolioInteractions() {
        const portfolioCategories = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-category');
        
        portfolioCategories.forEach(category => {
            category.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const categoryName = category.dataset.category;
                this.showCategoryDetails(categoryName);
            });
        });
    }

    // Show Category Details
    showCategoryDetails(category) {
        // Create modal for category details
        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'category-modal';
        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h2>${category.toUpperCase()}</h2>
                    <button class="close-modal">&times;</button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <p>This is the ${category} section. Here you can add detailed content about your ${category} experiences and projects.</p>
                    <div class="modal-image">
                        <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/400x300/F5E6D3/333333?text=${category.toUpperCase()}" alt="${category}">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        // Style the modal
        modal.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 10000;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        `;
        
        const modalContent = modal.querySelector('.modal-content');
        modalContent.style.cssText = `
            background: #FFE135;
            padding: 2rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 90%;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transform: scale(0.8);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            border: 3px solid #000;
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            modal.style.opacity = '1';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
        }, 100);
        
        // Close modal functionality
        const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.close-modal');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            modal.style.opacity = '0';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (modal.parentNode) {
                    modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                }
            }, 300);
        });
        
        modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) {
                modal.style.opacity = '0';
                modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (modal.parentNode) {
                        modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    setupLoadingAnimation() {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
            
            // Staggered fade-in animation
            nameParts.forEach((part, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    part.classList.add('fade-in');
                }, index * 200);
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                navItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        item.classList.add('fade-in');
                    }, index * 300);
                });
            }, 1000);

            // Add loaded class to body
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Marquee Control
    setupMarqueeControl() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        
        if (marqueeContent) {
            // Pause on hover
            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
            });

            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
            });

            // Speed control based on window size
            this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            });
        }
    }

    // Update Marquee Speed
    updateMarqueeSpeed() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        if (marqueeContent) {
            const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let duration;
            
            if (windowWidth < 480) {
                duration = '15s';
            } else if (windowWidth < 768) {
                duration = '18s';
            } else {
                duration = '20s';
            }
            
            marqueeContent.style.animationDuration = duration;
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    setupKeyboardNavigation() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                // Close any open sections
                this.collapseSection();
                
                // Close any open modals
                const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.category-modal');
                modals.forEach(modal => {
                    modal.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (modal.parentNode) {
                            modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                        }
                    }, 300);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // Cleanup
    destroy() {
        // Clear blinking timers
        this.blinkTimers.forEach(timer => {
            clearInterval(timer);
        });
        
        // Remove event listeners
        document.removeEventListener('click', this.collapseSection);
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
    
    // Add portfolio interactions setup
    setTimeout(() => {
        app.setupPortfolioInteractions();
    }, 1000);
    
    // Add loading state management
    document.body.classList.add('loading');
    
    // Performance optimization
    window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
        app.updateMarqueeSpeed();
    }, 250));
    
    // Cleanup on page unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
        app.destroy();
    });
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'block';
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = AdvancedPortfolioApp;
```

現在也更新眨眼功能中的眼球邊框顏色：


```javascript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features
class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    constructor() {
        this.currentPage = 'hero';
        this.currentColorIndex = 0;
        this.colorSequence = ['black', 'white', 'orange'];
        this.isBlinking = false;
        this.blinkTimers = [];
        this.expandedSection = null;
        
        this.init();
    }

    init() {
        this.setupCatCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupColorChanges();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupNavItemExpansion();
        this.setupMouseEnterEffects();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
        this.setupMarqueeControl();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
    }

    // Cat Paw Cursor
    setupCatCursor() {
        const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
        
        if (catCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
                catCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                catCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Change cursor on hover
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach(el => {
                el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.5)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#FFA500';
                });
                
                el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    catCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                    catCursor.querySelector('.paw-print').style.background = '#000';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    catCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };
            mediaQuery.addListener(handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations with Both Eyes Moving
    setupEyeAnimations() {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye, index) => {
            // Both eyes blink independently
            const blinkInterval = setInterval(() => {
                if (!this.isBlinking) {
                    this.blinkEye(eye);
                }
            }, 3000 + (index * 1000)); // 1 second delay between eyes
            
            this.blinkTimers.push(blinkInterval);
        });
    }

    // Blink Eye Function with Dynamic Eyelid Color
    blinkEye(eye) {
        const eyelidTop = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-top');
        const eyelidBottom = eye.querySelector('.eyelid-bottom');
        const eyeball = eye.querySelector('.eyeball');
        
        this.isBlinking = true;
        
        // Update eyelid color based on current theme
        const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        eyelidTop.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidBottom.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyelidTop.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        eyelidBottom.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        
        // Update eyeball border color based on current theme
        eyeball.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        eyeball.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
        
        // Close eyelids
        eyelidTop.classList.add('blinking');
        eyelidBottom.classList.add('blinking');
        
        // Change eyeball color to yellow during blink
        eyeball.style.background = '#FFE135';
        
        // Reopen after 0.5 seconds
        setTimeout(() => {
            eyelidTop.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyelidBottom.classList.remove('blinking');
            eyeball.style.background = '#fff';
            this.isBlinking = false;
        }, 500);
    }

    // Color Changes Every 3 Seconds
    setupColorChanges() {
        setInterval(() => {
            this.changeColorTheme();
        }, 3000);
        
        // Initial color change
        this.changeColorTheme();
    }

    // Change Color Theme
    changeColorTheme() {
        const colorClass = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
        
        // Remove all color classes
        document.body.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
        
        // Add new color class
        document.body.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        
        // Update current page background
        this.updatePageBackground(colorClass);
        
        // Update eyelid colors for all eyes
        this.updateEyelidColors(colorClass);
        
        // Move to next color
        this.currentColorIndex = (this.currentColorIndex + 1) % this.colorSequence.length;
    }

    // Update Eyelid Colors
    updateEyelidColors(colorClass) {
        const eyelids = document.querySelectorAll('.eyelid-top, .eyelid-bottom');
        eyelids.forEach(eyelid => {
            eyelid.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            eyelid.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        });
        
        // Update eyeball border colors
        const eyeballs = document.querySelectorAll('.eyeball');
        eyeballs.forEach(eyeball => {
            eyeball.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            eyeball.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        });
    }

    // Update Page Background
    updatePageBackground(colorClass) {
        const activePage = document.querySelector('.page-section.active');
        if (activePage) {
            activePage.classList.remove('color-black', 'color-white', 'color-orange');
            activePage.classList.add(`color-${colorClass}`);
        }
    }

    // Page Navigation
    setupPageNavigation() {
        // Scroll detection for page switching
        let lastScrollY = window.scrollY;
        
        window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
            const currentScrollY = window.scrollY;
            const windowHeight = window.innerHeight;
            
            // Determine current page based on scroll position
            if (currentScrollY < windowHeight / 2) {
                this.switchToPage('hero');
            } else {
                this.switchToPage('navigation');
            }
            
            lastScrollY = currentScrollY;
        });
    }

    // Switch Page
    switchToPage(pageName) {
        if (this.currentPage !== pageName) {
            this.currentPage = pageName;
            
            // Update active page
            document.querySelectorAll('.page-section').forEach(section => {
                section.classList.remove('active');
            });
            
            const targetPage = document.querySelector(`#${pageName}`);
            if (targetPage) {
                targetPage.classList.add('active');
                
                // Update background color based on current theme
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                targetPage.classList.add(`color-${currentColor}`);
            }
        }
    }

    // Navigation Item Expansion
    setupNavItemExpansion() {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        
        navItems.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const section = item.dataset.section;
                
                if (this.expandedSection === section) {
                    // Collapse if already expanded
                    this.collapseSection();
                } else {
                    // Expand new section
                    this.expandSection(section);
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Click outside to close
        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (!e.target.closest('.nav-item')) {
                this.collapseSection();
            }
        });
    }

    // Expand Section
    expandSection(sectionName) {
        // Collapse any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        
        const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${sectionName}"]`);
        if (navItem) {
            navItem.classList.add('expanded');
            this.expandedSection = sectionName;
        }
    }

    // Collapse Section
    collapseSection() {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            const navItem = document.querySelector(`[data-section="${this.expandedSection}"]`);
            if (navItem) {
                navItem.classList.remove('expanded');
            }
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    // Mouse Enter Effects
    setupMouseEnterEffects() {
        const pageSections = document.querySelectorAll('.page-section');
        
        pageSections.forEach(section => {
            section.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                // Change current page background to contrast color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                let contrastColor;
                
                switch(currentColor) {
                    case 'black':
                        contrastColor = 'white';
                        break;
                    case 'white':
                        contrastColor = 'black';
                        break;
                    case 'orange':
                        contrastColor = 'gray';
                        break;
                }
                
                // Apply contrast background
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(contrastColor);
                
                // Reset other pages to default
                pageSections.forEach(otherSection => {
                    if (otherSection !== section) {
                        otherSection.style.background = '#FFE135';
                    }
                });
            });
            
            section.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                // Reset to current theme color
                const currentColor = this.colorSequence[this.currentColorIndex];
                section.style.background = this.getColorValue(currentColor);
            });
        });
    }

    // Get Color Value
    getColorValue(colorName) {
        switch(colorName) {
            case 'black': return '#000';
            case 'white': return '#fff';
            case 'orange': return '#FFA500';
            case 'gray': return '#666';
            default: return '#FFE135';
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Category Interactions
    setupPortfolioInteractions() {
        const portfolioCategories = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-category');
        
        portfolioCategories.forEach(category => {
            category.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const categoryName = category.dataset.category;
                this.showCategoryDetails(categoryName);
            });
        });
    }

    // Show Category Details
    showCategoryDetails(category) {
        // Create modal for category details
        const modal = document.createElement('div');
        modal.className = 'category-modal';
        modal.innerHTML = `
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h2>${category.toUpperCase()}</h2>
                    <button class="close-modal">&times;</button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body">
                    <p>This is the ${category} section. Here you can add detailed content about your ${category} experiences and projects.</p>
                    <div class="modal-image">
                        <img src="https://via.placeholder.com/400x300/F5E6D3/333333?text=${category.toUpperCase()}" alt="${category}">
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `;
        
        // Style the modal
        modal.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 10000;
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        `;
        
        const modalContent = modal.querySelector('.modal-content');
        modalContent.style.cssText = `
            background: #FFE135;
            padding: 2rem;
            border-radius: 20px;
            max-width: 600px;
            width: 90%;
            max-height: 80vh;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transform: scale(0.8);
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
            border: 3px solid #000;
        `;
        
        document.body.appendChild(modal);
        
        // Animate in
        setTimeout(() => {
            modal.style.opacity = '1';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(1)';
        }, 100);
        
        // Close modal functionality
        const closeBtn = modal.querySelector('.close-modal');
        closeBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            modal.style.opacity = '0';
            modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (modal.parentNode) {
                    modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                }
            }, 300);
        });
        
        modal.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target === modal) {
                modal.style.opacity = '0';
                modalContent.style.transform = 'scale(0.8)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (modal.parentNode) {
                        modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                    }
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    setupLoadingAnimation() {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
            
            // Staggered fade-in animation
            nameParts.forEach((part, index) => {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    part.classList.add('fade-in');
                }, index * 200);
            });

            setTimeout(() => {
                navItems.forEach((item, index) => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        item.classList.add('fade-in');
                    }, index * 300);
                });
            }, 1000);

            // Add loaded class to body
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Marquee Control
    setupMarqueeControl() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        
        if (marqueeContent) {
            // Pause on hover
            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'paused';
            });

            marqueeContent.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                marqueeContent.style.animationPlayState = 'running';
            });

            // Speed control based on window size
            this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
                this.updateMarqueeSpeed();
            });
        }
    }

    // Update Marquee Speed
    updateMarqueeSpeed() {
        const marqueeContent = document.querySelector('.marquee-content');
        if (marqueeContent) {
            const windowWidth = window.innerWidth;
            let duration;
            
            if (windowWidth < 480) {
                duration = '15s';
            } else if (windowWidth < 768) {
                duration = '18s';
            } else {
                duration = '20s';
            }
            
            marqueeContent.style.animationDuration = duration;
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    setupKeyboardNavigation() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') {
                // Close any open sections
                this.collapseSection();
                
                // Close any open modals
                const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.category-modal');
                modals.forEach(modal => {
                    modal.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (modal.parentNode) {
                            modal.parentNode.removeChild(modal);
                        }
                    }, 300);
                });
            }
        });
    }

    // Cleanup
    destroy() {
        // Clear blinking timers
        this.blinkTimers.forEach(timer => {
            clearInterval(timer);
        });
        
        // Remove event listeners
        document.removeEventListener('click', this.collapseSection);
    }
}

// Utility Functions
const utils = {
    // Debounce function
    debounce(func, wait) {
        let timeout;
        return function executedFunction(...args) {
            const later = () => {
                clearTimeout(timeout);
                func(...args);
            };
            clearTimeout(timeout);
            timeout = setTimeout(later, wait);
        };
    },

    // Throttle function
    throttle(func, limit) {
        let inThrottle;
        return function() {
            const args = arguments;
            const context = this;
            if (!inThrottle) {
                func.apply(context, args);
                inThrottle = true;
                setTimeout(() => inThrottle = false, limit);
            }
        };
    }
};

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const app = new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
    
    // Add portfolio interactions setup
    setTimeout(() => {
        app.setupPortfolioInteractions();
    }, 1000);
    
    // Add loading state management
    document.body.classList.add('loading');
    
    // Performance optimization
    window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
        app.updateMarqueeSpeed();
    }, 250));
    
    // Cleanup on page unload
    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
        app.destroy();
    });
});

// Handle window resize
window.addEventListener('resize', utils.debounce(() => {
    // Handle responsive adjustments
    const catCursor = document.querySelector('.cat-cursor');
    if (window.innerWidth <= 768 && catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'none';
    } else if (catCursor) {
        catCursor.style.display = 'block';
    }
}, 250));

// Export for potential module use
if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
    module.exports = AdvancedPortfolioApp;
}
```

## ✨ **眼睛外框修復**

### **�� 問題解決**
- **移除白色圓形線條**：將眼球邊框設為透明，避免不必要的白色線條
- **動態邊框顏色**：眼球邊框現在會跟隨頁面主題顏色變化

### ** 顏色系統**
- **黑色主題**：眼球邊框變為黑色
- **白色主題**：眼球邊框變為白色  
- **橘色主題**：眼球邊框變為橘色

### **⚡ 同步更新**
- **眨眼時更新**：每次眨眼時都會更新邊框顏色
- **主題變換時更新**：每3秒主題變換時同步更新邊框顏色
- **平滑過渡**：邊框顏色變化有0.3秒的平滑過渡效果

### **�� 視覺效果**
- **無縫整合**：邊框顏色與眼皮顏色完美協調
- **動態響應**：所有顏色變化都保持同步
- **視覺一致性**：整個眼睛設計保持視覺一致性

```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 200vh; /* 2 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid transparent; /* Transparent border initially */
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eyeball border colors based on page theme */
.eyeball.color-black {
    border-color: #000;
}

.eyeball.color-white {
    border-color: #fff;
}

.eyeball.color-orange {
    border-color: #FFA500;
}

.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Eyelid colors based on page theme */
.eyelid-top.color-black,
.eyelid-bottom.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.eyelid-top.color-white,
.eyelid-bottom.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.eyelid-top.color-orange,
.eyelid-bottom.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Default color */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 4rem 2rem;
    gap: 3rem;
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 6rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 80px;
    height: 80px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: flex;
    gap: 2rem;
    overflow-x: auto;
    padding: 2rem 0;
    justify-content: center;
    max-width: 100%;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    height: 120px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Banner */
.marquee-banner {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background: #000;
    color: #fff;
    padding: 15px 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: nowrap;
    z-index: 100;
}

.marquee-content {
    display: inline-block;
    animation: marquee 3s linear infinite;
    padding-left: 100%;
}

.marquee-text {
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-right: 50px;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(0%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;

}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;

}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;

}

.portfolio-category .category-image {

    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;

}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;

}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;

}

.social-links {
    display: flex;

    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 12px;
    height: 12px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -5px;
    left: 5px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -5px;
    right: 5px;
}

.paw-print::after::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: 15px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
```
