```css
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Container in Middle */
.marquee-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px; /* Match DANIEL line width */
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    order: 2; /* Ensure it's in the middle */
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 12s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;
    top: 0;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.name-line.top-line {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    order: 1; /* Top line comes first */
}

.name-line.bottom-line {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    order: 3; /* Bottom line comes last */
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {

    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {

.eyeball {

.eyeball.color-black {

.pupil {

}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,

    position: absolute;

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;

}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;

}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */

.circle-text {

}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {

.circle-text p {

}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {

}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;

}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

移除眼球邊框的動態顏色：


```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.name-line.top-line {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    order: 1; /* Top line comes first */
}

.name-line.bottom-line {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    order: 3; /* Bottom line comes last */
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid transparent; /* Transparent border initially */
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Fixed eyeball border color */
.eyeball {
    border-color: #000;
}

.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
    height: 50vh; /* 0.5 screen height */
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu - Hidden due to limited space */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: none;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;

/* Marquee Container in Middle */
.marquee-container {

    height: 60px;

    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;

.marquee-content {

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;

    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;

}

@keyframes marquee {

    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;

    z-index: 1000;

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {

    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

修正眼球邊框設定：


```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.name-line.top-line {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    order: 1; /* Top line comes first */
}

.name-line.bottom-line {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    order: 3; /* Bottom line comes last */
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid #000; /* Fixed black border */
}

/* Fixed eyeball border color */
.eyeball {
    border-color: #000;
}

.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
    height: 50vh; /* 0.5 screen height */
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu - Hidden due to limited space */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: none;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    height: 120px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Container in Middle */
.marquee-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px; /* Match DANIEL line width */
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    order: 2; /* Ensure it's in the middle */
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 12s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;
    top: 0;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

```css
    max-width: 800px; /* Match DANIEL line width */
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    order: 2; /* Ensure it's in the middle */
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 12s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;
    top: 0;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

設定游標固定為灰色：


```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.name-line.top-line {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    order: 1; /* Top line comes first */
}

.name-line.bottom-line {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    order: 3; /* Bottom line comes last */
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid #000; /* Fixed black border */
}


.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
    height: 50vh; /* 0.5 screen height */
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {

.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;

    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }

        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {

        height: 20px;
    }
```

設定所有爪子為灰色：


```css
/* CSS Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */
    color: #000;
    overflow-x: hidden;
    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */
.main-container {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Page Sections */
.page-section {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.nav-page.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

/* Hero Page */
.hero-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.name-section {
    text-align: center;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    height: 100vh;
}

.name-line {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 2rem;
}

.name-line.top-line {
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
    order: 1; /* Top line comes first */
}

.name-line.bottom-line {
    margin-top: 2rem;
    order: 3; /* Bottom line comes last */
}

.name-part {
    font-size: 8rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 0.8;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Eye Container */
.eye-container {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

/* Eye Design with Eyeball and Pupil */
.eye {
    width: 120px;
    height: 120px;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.eyeball {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    background: #fff; /* White eyeball */
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 4px solid #000; /* Fixed black border */
}


.pupil {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: all 0.1s ease;
}

/* Eyelids */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50%;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
    z-index: 3;
}

.eyelid-top {
    top: 0;
    border-radius: 120px 120px 0 0;
}

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
    height: 50vh; /* 0.5 screen height */
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu - Hidden due to limited space */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: none;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    height: 120px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Container in Middle */
.marquee-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px; /* Match DANIEL line width */
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    order: 2; /* Ensure it's in the middle */
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 12s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;
    top: 0;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

        font-size: 4rem;
```
```css
    }

.eyelid-bottom {
    bottom: 0;
    border-radius: 0 0 120px 120px;
}

/* Fixed eyelid color - always light yellow */
.eyelid-top,
.eyelid-bottom {
    background: #FFE135;
}

/* Blinking Animation */
.eyelid-top.blinking {
    transform: translateY(-60px);
}

.eyelid-bottom.blinking {
    transform: translateY(60px);
}

/* Navigation Page */
.nav-page {
    padding: 2rem 2rem;
    gap: 1rem;
    height: 50vh; /* 0.5 screen height */
}

.main-nav {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.nav-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 1rem;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-text {
    font-size: 4rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-eye {
    width: 60px;
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 900;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Portfolio Submenu - Hidden due to limited space */
.portfolio-submenu {
    display: none;
}

.submenu-item {
    flex: 0 0 200px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.submenu-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.submenu-box {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    text-align: center;
    height: 250px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.submenu-box h3 {
    font-size: 1.5rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.image-placeholder {
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    height: 120px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Marquee Container in Middle */
.marquee-container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 800px; /* Match DANIEL line width */
    height: 60px;
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 30px;
    margin: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    order: 2; /* Ensure it's in the middle */
}

.marquee-content {
    display: flex;
    animation: marquee 12s linear infinite;
    white-space: nowrap;
}

.marquee-text {
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 0 2rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

@keyframes marquee {
    0% { transform: translateX(100%); }
    100% { transform: translateX(-100%); }
}

/* Navigation Items with Expansion */
.nav-item {
    position: relative;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item.expanded {
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100vh;
    z-index: 1000;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    background: rgba(255, 225, 53, 0.95);
    backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
}

/* About Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded {
    height: 50vh;
    top: 25vh;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"] .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #fff;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    transition: all 1s ease;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle {
    width: 50vw;
    height: 50vw;
    max-width: 400px;
    max-height: 400px;
}

.circle-text {
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease 0.5s;
}

.nav-item[data-section="about"].expanded .nav-content .about-circle .circle-text {
    opacity: 1;
}

.circle-text p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #333;
}

/* Portfolio Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded {
    height: 100vh;
    top: 0;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"] .portfolio-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="portfolio"].expanded .portfolio-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.portfolio-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2rem;
    max-width: 1000px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.portfolio-category {
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 2rem;
    text-align: center;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.portfolio-category:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
}

.portfolio-category h3 {
    font-size: 2rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.portfolio-category p {
    font-size: 1rem;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

.portfolio-category .category-image {
    width: 100%;
    height: 200px;
    background: #f0f0f0;
    border: 2px dashed #ccc;
    border-radius: 10px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    color: #666;
    font-style: italic;
    margin: 1rem 0;
}

/* Contact Page Expansion */
.nav-item[data-section="contact"] .contact-content {
    display: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: all 0.5s ease;
}

.nav-item[data-section="contact"].expanded .contact-content {
    display: block;
    opacity: 1;
}

.contact-content {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 2rem;
}

.contact-content h2 {
    font-size: 3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #000;
    margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.social-links {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 3rem;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.social-link {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #000;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Contrast colors based on page theme */
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-black .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #fff;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-white .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #000;
}

.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::before,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print::after,
.cat-cursor.contrast-orange .paw-print .claw-3 {
    background: #666;
}

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
        font-size: 1.2rem;
    }
    
    .about-circle.active {
        width: 80vw;
        height: 80vw;
    }
    
    .circle-text p {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
}

/* Animation Classes */
.fade-in {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
}

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Smooth Transitions */
* {
    transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;
}

/* Loading Animation */
.loading {
    opacity: 0;
}

.loaded {
    opacity: 1;
}

/* Accessibility */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .marquee-content {
        animation: none;
    }
    
    .eyelid-top,
    .eyelid-bottom {
        transition: none;
    }
    
    * {
        transition: none;
    }
}

/* Scrollbar Styling */
.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar {
    height: 8px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background: #000;
    border-radius: 4px;
}

.portfolio-submenu::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
    background: #333;
}
```

```css
/* CSS Reset */

    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {

    background: #FFE135; /* Egg yolk yellow background */

    cursor: none;
    height: 150vh; /* 1.5 main pages height */
}

/* Main Container */

    position: relative;

}

    display: flex;

    position: relative;
    transition: background-color 0.5s ease;
}

.page-section.active {
    background-color: #FFE135;
}

.page-section.hero-page.active {

}

.page-section.nav-page.active {

    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    padding: 1.5rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 3px solid #000;
    border-radius: 15px;
    min-width: 150px;
}

.social-link:hover {
    transform: translateY(-10px);
    background: #FFA500;
    color: #fff;
}

/* Cat Paw Cursor */
.cat-cursor {
    position: fixed;
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 9999;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    transition: transform 0.1s ease;
}

.paw-print {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%;
    position: relative;
    transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

/* Three small circles for claws */
.paw-print::before,
.paw-print::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50%;
}

.paw-print::before {
    top: -8px;
    left: 8px;
}

.paw-print::after {
    top: -8px;
    right: 8px;
}

/* Third claw */
.paw-print .claw-3 {
    position: absolute;
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    background: #666; /* Fixed gray color */
    border-radius: 50%;
    top: -8px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
}

/* Cursor is now fixed gray color */

/* Color Themes */
.color-black .name-part,
.color-black .nav-text {
    color: #000;
}

.color-white .name-part,
.color-white .nav-text {
    color: #fff;
}

.color-orange .name-part,
.color-orange .nav-text {
    color: #FFA500;
}

/* Page Background Colors */
.hero-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.hero-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.hero-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

.nav-page.color-black {
    background: #fff;
}

.nav-page.color-white {
    background: #000;
}

.nav-page.color-orange {
    background: #666;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 6rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 120px;
        height: 120px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 100px;
        height: 100px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 30px;
        height: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 4rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .name-line {
        gap: 1rem;
    }
    
    .eye-container {
        width: 80px;
        height: 80px;
    }
    
    .eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }
    
    .pupil {
        width: 20px;
        height: 20px;
    }
    
    .nav-eye {
        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
        font-size: 1.5rem;
    }
    
    .portfolio-submenu {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .submenu-item {
        flex: none;
        width: 100%;
        max-width: 300px;
    }
    
    .marquee-text {
        font-size: 0.8rem;
    }
    
    .cat-cursor {
        display: none;
    }
    
    body {
        cursor: auto;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .name-part {
        font-size: 3rem;
    }
    
    .nav-text {
        font-size: 2.5rem;

        width: 60px;
        height: 60px;
    }

        width: 50px;
        height: 50px;
    }

        width: 15px;
        height: 15px;
    }
```
