```typescript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features (TypeScript)
import { EyeAnimation, PortfolioItem, ContactFormData, SectionType, PageType, MediaQueryEvent } from './types';

class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    private currentPage: PageType = 'hero';
    private eyeTimers: EyeAnimation[] = [];
    private expandedSection: HTMLElement | null = null;
    private portfolioItems: PortfolioItem[] = [];

    constructor() {
        this.init();
    }

    private init(): void {
        this.setupCircleCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupSubPageExpansion();
        this.setupScrollArrow();
        this.setupPortfolioFilter();
        this.setupScrollAnimations();
        this.setupContactForm();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
    }

    // Circle Cursor
    private setupCircleCursor(): void {
        const circleCursor = document.querySelector('.circle-cursor') as HTMLElement;
        
        if (circleCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e: MouseEvent) => {
                circleCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                circleCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Circle hover effect
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
                const element = el as HTMLElement;
                element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2)';
                });
                
                element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e: MediaQueryEvent) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };

            mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery as any);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations
    private setupEyeAnimations(): void {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye: Element) => {
            const eyeElement = eye as HTMLElement;
            this.eyeTimers.push({ element: eyeElement });
            this.startEyeAnimation(eyeElement);
        });
    }

    private startEyeAnimation(eye: HTMLElement): void {
        const animateEye = (): void => {
            const randomDelay = Math.random() * 3000 + 1000; // 1-4 seconds
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (eye.parentElement?.closest('.page-section.active')) {
                    this.blinkEye(eye);
                    animateEye();
                }
            }, randomDelay);
        };

        animateEye();
    }

    private blinkEye(eye: HTMLElement): void {
        const eyeball = eye.querySelector('.eyeball') as HTMLElement;
        if (!eyeball) return;

        eyeball.style.transform = 'scaleY(0.1)';
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            eyeball.style.transform = 'scaleY(1)';
        }, 150);
    }

    // Page Navigation
    private setupPageNavigation(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.getElementById('scrollArrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            scrollArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                this.scrollToNextPage();
            });
        }

        // Scroll-based page switching
        let isScrolling = false;
        window.addEventListener('wheel', (e: WheelEvent) => {
            if (isScrolling) return;
            
            isScrolling = true;
            
            if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                this.scrollToNextPage();
            } else {
                this.scrollToPreviousPage();
            }
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                isScrolling = false;
            }, 1000);
        });
    }

    private scrollToNextPage(): void {
        const currentSection = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        const nextSection = currentSection?.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement;
        
        if (nextSection) {
            this.switchToPage(nextSection);
        }
    }

    private scrollToPreviousPage(): void {
        const currentSection = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        const prevSection = currentSection?.previousElementSibling as HTMLElement;
        
        if (prevSection) {
            this.switchToPage(prevSection);
        }
    }

    private switchToPage(section: HTMLElement): void {
        const currentActive = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        
        if (currentActive) {
            currentActive.classList.remove('active');
        }
        
        section.classList.add('active');
        
        // Update current page
        if (section.id === 'hero') {
            this.currentPage = 'hero';
        } else {
            this.currentPage = 'nav';
        }
    }

    // Sub-page expansion functionality
    private setupSubPageExpansion(): void {
        const subPages = document.querySelectorAll('.sub-page');
        
        subPages.forEach((subPage: Element) => {
            const page = subPage as HTMLElement;
            page.addEventListener('click', (e: MouseEvent) => {
                // Don't trigger if clicking on form elements
                if (this.isInteractiveElement(e.target as Element)) {
                    return;
                }
                
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const section = page.dataset.section as SectionType;
                
                if (page.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                    // Collapse the section
                    this.collapseSection();
                } else {
                    // Expand the section
                    this.expandSection(page, section);
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Click anywhere to close
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: MouseEvent) => {
            if (this.expandedSection) {
                // Don't close if clicking on interactive elements
                const isInteractiveElement = this.isInteractiveElement(e.target as Element);
                
                if (!isInteractiveElement) {
                    // Close on any other click (including content area)
                    this.collapseSection();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private isInteractiveElement(element: Element): boolean {
        return !!(
            element.closest('.contact-form') ||
            element.closest('.filter-buttons') ||
            element.closest('.portfolio-item') ||
            element.closest('.view-project') ||
            element.closest('input') ||
            element.closest('textarea') ||
            element.closest('button') ||
            element.closest('a')
        );
    }

    private expandSection(subPage: HTMLElement, section: SectionType): void {
        // Close any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        
        // Expand the new section
        subPage.classList.add('expanded');
        this.expandedSection = subPage;
        
        // Show hint after 10 minutes (600,000 milliseconds)
        // For testing: change to 30000 (30 seconds) to see the effect quickly
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (subPage.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                subPage.classList.add('show-hint');
            }
        }, 600000);
        
        // Auto-play videos when section expands
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.playVideosInSection(subPage);
        }, 500); // Wait for animation to complete
    }

    private collapseSection(): void {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('expanded');
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('show-hint');
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    private playVideosInSection(section: HTMLElement): void {
        const videos = section.querySelectorAll('video') as NodeListOf<HTMLVideoElement>;
        videos.forEach((video: HTMLVideoElement) => {
            video.play().catch(() => {
                // Ignore autoplay errors
            });
        });
    }

    // Scroll Arrow
    private setupScrollArrow(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.getElementById('scrollArrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            // Animate arrow
            const animateArrow = (): void => {
                scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(10px)';
                }, 1500);
                setTimeout(animateArrow, 3000);
            };
            
            animateArrow();
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Filter
    private setupPortfolioFilter(): void {
        const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        // Initialize portfolio items
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            const category = element.dataset.category || '';
            this.portfolioItems.push({
                element,
                category,
                isVisible: false
            });
        });

        filterButtons.forEach((button: Element) => {
            const btn = button as HTMLButtonElement;
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Remove active class from all buttons
                filterButtons.forEach((b: Element) => {
                    (b as HTMLButtonElement).classList.remove('active');
                });
                
                // Add active class to clicked button
                btn.classList.add('active');
                
                // Filter items
                const filter = btn.dataset.filter || '';
                this.filterPortfolioItems(filter);
            });
        });

        // Initialize with 'school' filter active
        this.filterPortfolioItems('school');
    }

    private filterPortfolioItems(filter: string): void {
        this.portfolioItems.forEach((item: PortfolioItem) => {
            const shouldShow = item.category === filter;
            
            if (shouldShow) {
                item.element.style.display = 'block';
                item.element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                item.isVisible = true;
                
                // Trigger animation
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.opacity = '1';
                    item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, 100);
            } else {
                item.element.style.opacity = '0';
                item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.display = 'none';
                    item.element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                    item.isVisible = false;
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    private setupScrollAnimations(): void {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries: IntersectionObserverEntry[]) => {
            entries.forEach((entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('animate-in');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-slide-up, .animate-fade-up, .animate-slide-left');
        animatedElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    }

    // Contact Form
    private setupContactForm(): void {
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form') as HTMLFormElement;
        
        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e: Event) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.handleFormSubmit(form);
            });
        }
    }

    private handleFormSubmit(form: HTMLFormElement): void {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data: ContactFormData = {
            name: formData.get('name') as string,
            email: formData.get('email') as string,
            subject: formData.get('subject') as string,
            message: formData.get('message') as string
        };

        // Simulate form submission
        console.log('Form submitted:', data);
        
        // Show success message
        this.showFormMessage('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
        form.reset();
    }

    private showFormMessage(message: string, type: 'success' | 'error'): void {
        const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
        messageElement.className = `form-message ${type}`;
        messageElement.textContent = message;
        
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.appendChild(messageElement);
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                messageElement.remove();
            }, 3000);
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    private setupKeyboardNavigation(): void {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToNextPage();
                    break;
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToPreviousPage();
                    break;
                case 'Escape':
                    this.collapseSection();
                    break;
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    private setupLoadingAnimation(): void {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
            
            // Animate name parts
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            nameParts.forEach((part: Element, index: number) => {
                const element = part as HTMLElement;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    element.style.opacity = '1';
                    element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, index * 200);
            });
        });
    }
}

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
});

export default AdvancedPortfolioApp;

```markdown
# Daniel Wu Portfolio - TypeScript Version

## 專案說明

這是 Daniel Wu 的互動式作品集網站，使用 TypeScript 開發動態網頁功能。

## 技術架構

### 前端技術
- **HTML5**: 網頁結構
- **CSS3**: 樣式設計和動畫效果
- **TypeScript**: 動態網頁功能開發

### 專案結構
```
hw1/
├── index.html              # 主頁面
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── styles.css      # 樣式文件
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js          # 編譯後的 JavaScript (從 TypeScript)
│       ├── app.js.map      # Source Map
│       ├── types.js        # 編譯後的類型定義
│       └── types.js.map    # Source Map
├── src/
│   ├── app.ts              # 主要 TypeScript 應用文件
│   └── types.ts            # TypeScript 類型定義
├── tsconfig.json           # TypeScript 配置
├── package.json            # 專案配置
└── README.md               # 說明文件
```

## TypeScript 特性

### 類型定義
- `EyeAnimation`: 眼睛動畫相關類型
- `PortfolioItem`: 作品項目類型
- `ContactFormData`: 聯絡表單數據類型
- `SectionType`: 頁面區塊類型
- `PageType`: 頁面類型

### 主要功能
1. **圓形游標**: 自定義游標效果
2. **眼睛動畫**: 隨機眨眼動畫
3. **頁面導航**: 滾動和鍵盤導航
4. **子頁面展開**: 圓形輻射展開動畫
5. **作品集篩選**: 動態篩選功能
6. **聯絡表單**: 表單處理和驗證
7. **響應式設計**: 適配不同螢幕尺寸

## 開發指令

### 編譯 TypeScript
```bash
tsc                    # 編譯所有 TypeScript 文件
tsc --watch           # 監聽模式，自動重新編譯
```

### 啟動開發服務器
```bash
python3 -m http.server 8004
```

打開瀏覽器訪問: `http://localhost:8004`

            setTimeout(() => {

                    this.blinkEye(eye);

        // Scroll-based page switching
        let isScrolling = false;

                if (this.isInteractiveElement(e.target)) {
                    return;

                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();

                else {

                    this.expandSection(page, section);

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {

                // Don't close if clicking on interactive elements
                const isInteractiveElement = this.isInteractiveElement(e.target);
                if (!isInteractiveElement) {
                    // Close on any other click (including content area)
                    this.collapseSection();
                }
            }
        });

    isInteractiveElement(element) {

            element.closest('.portfolio-item') ||
            element.closest('.view-project') ||
            element.closest('input') ||
            element.closest('textarea') ||
            element.closest('button') ||
            element.closest('a'));
    }
    expandSection(subPage, section) {
        // Close any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        // Expand the new section
        subPage.classList.add('expanded');
        this.expandedSection = subPage;
        // Show hint after 10 minutes (600,000 milliseconds)
        // For testing: change to 30000 (30 seconds) to see the effect quickly
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (subPage.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                subPage.classList.add('show-hint');
            }
        }, 600000);
        // Auto-play videos when section expands
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.playVideosInSection(subPage);
        }, 500); // Wait for animation to complete
    }
    collapseSection() {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('expanded');
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('show-hint');
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }
    playVideosInSection(section) {
        const videos = section.querySelectorAll('video');
        videos.forEach((video) => {
            video.play().catch(() => {
                // Ignore autoplay errors
            });
        });
    }
    // Scroll Arrow
    setupScrollArrow() {
        const scrollArrow = document.getElementById('scrollArrow');
        if (scrollArrow) {
            // Animate arrow
            const animateArrow = () => {
                scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(10px)';
                }, 1500);
                setTimeout(animateArrow, 3000);
            };
            animateArrow();
        }
    }
    // Portfolio Filter
    setupPortfolioFilter() {
        const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        // Initialize portfolio items
        portfolioItems.forEach((item) => {
            const element = item;
            const category = element.dataset.category || '';
            this.portfolioItems.push({
                element,
                category,
                isVisible: false
            });
        });
        filterButtons.forEach((button) => {
            const btn = button;
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Remove active class from all buttons
                filterButtons.forEach((b) => {
                    b.classList.remove('active');
                });
                // Add active class to clicked button
                btn.classList.add('active');
                // Filter items
                const filter = btn.dataset.filter || '';
                this.filterPortfolioItems(filter);
            });
        });
        // Initialize with 'school' filter active
        this.filterPortfolioItems('school');
    }
    filterPortfolioItems(filter) {
        this.portfolioItems.forEach((item) => {
            const shouldShow = item.category === filter;
            if (shouldShow) {
                item.element.style.display = 'block';
                item.element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                item.isVisible = true;
                // Trigger animation
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.opacity = '1';
                    item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, 100);
            }
            else {
                item.element.style.opacity = '0';
                item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.display = 'none';
                    item.element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                    item.isVisible = false;
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }
    // Scroll Animations
    setupScrollAnimations() {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };
        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('animate-in');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);
        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-slide-up, .animate-fade-up, .animate-slide-left');
        animatedElements.forEach((el) => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    }
    // Contact Form
    setupContactForm() {
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.handleFormSubmit(form);
            });
        }
    }
    handleFormSubmit(form) {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data = {
            name: formData.get('name'),
            email: formData.get('email'),
            subject: formData.get('subject'),
            message: formData.get('message')
        };
        // Simulate form submission
        console.log('Form submitted:', data);
        // Show success message
        this.showFormMessage('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
        form.reset();
    }
    showFormMessage(message, type) {
        const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
        messageElement.className = `form-message ${type}`;
        messageElement.textContent = message;
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.appendChild(messageElement);
            setTimeout(() => {
                messageElement.remove();
            }, 3000);
        }
    }
    // Keyboard Navigation
    setupKeyboardNavigation() {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToNextPage();
                    break;
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToPreviousPage();
                    break;
                case 'Escape':
                    this.collapseSection();
                    break;
            }
        });
    }
    // Loading Animation
    setupLoadingAnimation() {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
            // Animate name parts
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            nameParts.forEach((part, index) => {
                const element = part;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    element.style.opacity = '1';
                    element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, index * 200);
            });
        });
    }
}

```typescript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features (TypeScript)
import { EyeAnimation, PortfolioItem, ContactFormData, SectionType, PageType, MediaQueryEvent } from './types';

class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    private currentPage: PageType = 'hero';
    private eyeTimers: EyeAnimation[] = [];
    private expandedSection: HTMLElement | null = null;
    private portfolioItems: PortfolioItem[] = [];

    constructor() {
        this.init();
    }

    private init(): void {
        this.setupCircleCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupSubPageExpansion();
        this.setupScrollArrow();
        this.setupPortfolioFilter();
        this.setupScrollAnimations();
        this.setupContactForm();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
    }

    // Circle Cursor
    private setupCircleCursor(): void {
        const circleCursor = document.querySelector('.circle-cursor') as HTMLElement;
        
        if (circleCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e: MouseEvent) => {
                circleCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                circleCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Circle hover effect
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
                const element = el as HTMLElement;
                element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2)';
                });
                
                element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e: MediaQueryEvent) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };

            mediaQuery.addEventListener('change', handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery as any);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations
    private setupEyeAnimations(): void {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye: Element) => {
            const eyeElement = eye as HTMLElement;
            this.eyeTimers.push({ element: eyeElement });
            this.startEyeAnimation(eyeElement);
        });
    }

    private startEyeAnimation(eye: HTMLElement): void {
        const animateEye = (): void => {
            const randomDelay = Math.random() * 3000 + 1000; // 1-4 seconds
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                if (eye.parentElement?.closest('.page-section.active')) {
                    this.blinkEye(eye);
                    animateEye();
                }
            }, randomDelay);
        };

        animateEye();
    }

    private blinkEye(eye: HTMLElement): void {
        const eyeball = eye.querySelector('.eyeball') as HTMLElement;
        if (!eyeball) return;

        eyeball.style.transform = 'scaleY(0.1)';
        
        setTimeout(() => {
            eyeball.style.transform = 'scaleY(1)';
        }, 150);
    }

    // Page Navigation
    private setupPageNavigation(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.getElementById('scrollArrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            scrollArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                this.scrollToNextPage();
            });
        }

        // Scroll-based page switching
        let isScrolling = false;
        window.addEventListener('wheel', (e: WheelEvent) => {
            if (isScrolling) return;
            
            isScrolling = true;
            
            if (e.deltaY > 0) {
                this.scrollToNextPage();
            } else {
                this.scrollToPreviousPage();
            }
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                isScrolling = false;
            }, 1000);
        });
    }

    private scrollToNextPage(): void {
        const currentSection = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        const nextSection = currentSection?.nextElementSibling as HTMLElement;
        
        if (nextSection) {
            this.switchToPage(nextSection);
        }
    }

    private scrollToPreviousPage(): void {
        const currentSection = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        const prevSection = currentSection?.previousElementSibling as HTMLElement;
        
        if (prevSection) {
            this.switchToPage(prevSection);
        }
    }

    private switchToPage(section: HTMLElement): void {
        const currentActive = document.querySelector('.page-section.active') as HTMLElement;
        
        if (currentActive) {
            currentActive.classList.remove('active');
        }
        
        section.classList.add('active');
        
        // Update current page
        if (section.id === 'hero') {
            this.currentPage = 'hero';
        } else {
            this.currentPage = 'nav';
        }
    }

    // Sub-page expansion functionality
    private setupSubPageExpansion(): void {
        const subPages = document.querySelectorAll('.sub-page');
        
        subPages.forEach((subPage: Element) => {
            const page = subPage as HTMLElement;
            page.addEventListener('click', (e: MouseEvent) => {
                // Don't trigger if clicking on form elements
                if (this.isInteractiveElement(e.target as Element)) {
                    return;
                }
                
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const section = page.dataset.section as SectionType;
                
                if (page.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                    // Collapse the section
                    this.collapseSection();
                } else {
                    // Expand the section
                    this.expandSection(page, section);
                }
            });
        });
        
        // Click anywhere to close
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: MouseEvent) => {
            if (this.expandedSection) {
                // Don't close if clicking on interactive elements
                const isInteractiveElement = this.isInteractiveElement(e.target as Element);
                
                if (!isInteractiveElement) {
                    // Close on any other click (including content area)
                    this.collapseSection();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private isInteractiveElement(element: Element): boolean {
        return !!(
            element.closest('.contact-form') ||
            element.closest('.filter-buttons') ||
            element.closest('.portfolio-item') ||
            element.closest('.view-project') ||
            element.closest('input') ||
            element.closest('textarea') ||
            element.closest('button') ||
            element.closest('a')
        );
    }

    private expandSection(subPage: HTMLElement, section: SectionType): void {
        // Close any currently expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
        
        // Expand the new section
        subPage.classList.add('expanded');
        this.expandedSection = subPage;
        
        // Show hint after 10 minutes (600,000 milliseconds)
        // For testing: change to 30000 (30 seconds) to see the effect quickly
        setTimeout(() => {
            if (subPage.classList.contains('expanded')) {
                subPage.classList.add('show-hint');
            }
        }, 600000);
        
        // Auto-play videos when section expands
        setTimeout(() => {
            this.playVideosInSection(subPage);
        }, 500); // Wait for animation to complete
    }

    private collapseSection(): void {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('expanded');
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('show-hint');
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    private playVideosInSection(section: HTMLElement): void {
        const videos = section.querySelectorAll('video') as NodeListOf<HTMLVideoElement>;
        videos.forEach((video: HTMLVideoElement) => {
            video.play().catch(() => {
                // Ignore autoplay errors
            });
        });
    }

    // Scroll Arrow
    private setupScrollArrow(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.getElementById('scrollArrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            // Animate arrow
            const animateArrow = (): void => {
                scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    scrollArrow.style.transform = 'translateY(10px)';
                }, 1500);
                setTimeout(animateArrow, 3000);
            };
            
            animateArrow();
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Filter
    private setupPortfolioFilter(): void {
        const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        // Initialize portfolio items
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            const category = element.dataset.category || '';
            this.portfolioItems.push({
                element,
                category,
                isVisible: false
            });
        });

        filterButtons.forEach((button: Element) => {
            const btn = button as HTMLButtonElement;
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Remove active class from all buttons
                filterButtons.forEach((b: Element) => {
                    (b as HTMLButtonElement).classList.remove('active');
                });
                
                // Add active class to clicked button
                btn.classList.add('active');
                
                // Filter items
                const filter = btn.dataset.filter || '';
                this.filterPortfolioItems(filter);
            });
        });

        // Initialize with 'school' filter active
        this.filterPortfolioItems('school');
    }

    private filterPortfolioItems(filter: string): void {
        this.portfolioItems.forEach((item: PortfolioItem) => {
            const shouldShow = item.category === filter;
            
            if (shouldShow) {
                item.element.style.display = 'block';
                item.element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                item.isVisible = true;
                
                // Trigger animation
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.opacity = '1';
                    item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, 100);
            } else {
                item.element.style.opacity = '0';
                item.element.style.transform = 'translateY(20px)';
                
                setTimeout(() => {
                    item.element.style.display = 'none';
                    item.element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                    item.isVisible = false;
                }, 300);
            }
        });
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    private setupScrollAnimations(): void {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries: IntersectionObserverEntry[]) => {
            entries.forEach((entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('animate-in');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        const animatedElements = document.querySelectorAll('.animate-slide-up, .animate-fade-up, .animate-slide-left');
        animatedElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    }

    // Contact Form
    private setupContactForm(): void {
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form') as HTMLFormElement;
        
        if (form) {
            form.addEventListener('submit', (e: Event) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.handleFormSubmit(form);
            });
        }
    }

    private handleFormSubmit(form: HTMLFormElement): void {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data: ContactFormData = {
            name: formData.get('name') as string,
            email: formData.get('email') as string,
            subject: formData.get('subject') as string,
            message: formData.get('message') as string
        };

        // Simulate form submission
        console.log('Form submitted:', data);
        
        // Show success message
        this.showFormMessage('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
        form.reset();
    }

    private showFormMessage(message: string, type: 'success' | 'error'): void {
        const messageElement = document.createElement('div');
        messageElement.className = `form-message ${type}`;
        messageElement.textContent = message;
        
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.appendChild(messageElement);
            
            setTimeout(() => {
                messageElement.remove();
            }, 3000);
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    private setupKeyboardNavigation(): void {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            switch (e.key) {
                case 'ArrowDown':
                case 'PageDown':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToNextPage();
                    break;
                case 'ArrowUp':
                case 'PageUp':
                    e.preventDefault();
                    this.scrollToPreviousPage();
                    break;
                case 'Escape':
                    this.collapseSection();
                    break;
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    private setupLoadingAnimation(): void {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
            
            // Animate name parts
            const nameParts = document.querySelectorAll('.name-part');
            nameParts.forEach((part: Element, index: number) => {
                const element = part as HTMLElement;
                setTimeout(() => {
                    element.style.opacity = '1';
                    element.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }, index * 200);
            });
        });
    }
}

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
});

// AdvancedPortfolioApp class is now available globally

                circleCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';

            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');

現在讓我創建一個更簡單的 TypeScript 版本。我將直接把原始的 script.js 轉換為 TypeScript，保持所有功能：


讓我創建一個正確的 TypeScript 版本，直接基於原始的 script.js：


```typescript
// Daniel Wu Portfolio - Advanced Interactive Features (TypeScript Version)
class AdvancedPortfolioApp {
    private currentPage: string;
    private eyeTimers: number[];
    private expandedSection: HTMLElement | null;

    constructor() {
        this.currentPage = 'hero';
        this.eyeTimers = [];
        this.expandedSection = null;
        
        this.init();
    }

    private init(): void {
        this.setupCircleCursor();
        this.setupEyeAnimations();
        this.setupPageNavigation();
        this.setupSubPageExpansion();
        this.setupScrollArrow();
        this.setupPortfolioFilter();
        this.setupScrollAnimations();
        this.setupContactForm();
        this.setupKeyboardNavigation();
        this.setupLoadingAnimation();
    }

    // Circle Cursor
    private setupCircleCursor(): void {
        const circleCursor = document.querySelector('.circle-cursor') as HTMLElement;
        
        if (circleCursor) {
            document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e: MouseEvent) => {
                circleCursor.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
                circleCursor.style.top = e.clientY + 'px';
            });

            // Circle hover effect
            const interactiveElements = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item, .name-part');
            interactiveElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
                const element = el as HTMLElement;
                element.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1.2)';
                });
                
                element.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
                    circleCursor.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1)';
                });
            });

            // Hide on small screens
            const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(max-width: 768px)');
            const handleMediaQueryChange = (e: MediaQueryListEvent) => {
                if (e.matches) {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    circleCursor.style.display = 'block';
                }
            };

            mediaQuery.addListener(handleMediaQueryChange);
            handleMediaQueryChange(mediaQuery);
        }
    }

    // Eye Animations
    private setupEyeAnimations(): void {
        const eyes = document.querySelectorAll('.eye');
        
        eyes.forEach((eye: Element) => {
            const eyeElement = eye as HTMLElement;
            this.startRandomBlink(eyeElement);
        });
    }

    private startRandomBlink(eye: HTMLElement): void {
        const blink = () => {
            eye.style.transform = 'scaleY(0.1)';
            setTimeout(() => {
                eye.style.transform = 'scaleY(1)';
            }, 150);
            
            // Random interval between 2-5 seconds
            const nextBlink = Math.random() * 3000 + 2000;
            const timer = setTimeout(blink, nextBlink);
            this.eyeTimers.push(timer);
        };
        
        blink();
    }

    // Page Navigation
    private setupPageNavigation(): void {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        
        navItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            item.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const targetPage = (item as HTMLElement).dataset.page;
                if (targetPage) {
                    this.navigateToPage(targetPage);
                }
            });
        });

        // Close expanded sections when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
            if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.nav-item')) {
                this.collapseSection();
            }
        });
    }

    private navigateToPage(page: string): void {
        this.currentPage = page;
        this.updateActiveNavItem(page);
        
        // Scroll to page
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(page);
        if (targetElement) {
            targetElement.scrollIntoView({ 
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'start'
            });
        }
    }

    private updateActiveNavItem(activePage: string): void {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        navItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            if (element.dataset.page === activePage) {
                element.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                element.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
    }

    // Sub-page Expansion
    private setupSubPageExpansion(): void {
        const subPages = document.querySelectorAll('.sub-page');
        
        subPages.forEach((subPage: Element) => {
            subPage.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
                // Don't trigger if clicking on form elements
                if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.contact-form') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.filter-btn') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.portfolio-item') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.view-project') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('textarea') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a')) {
                    return;
                }

                const section = (subPage as HTMLElement).dataset.section;
                if (section) {
                    this.expandSection(subPage as HTMLElement, section as 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact');
                }
            });
        });

        // Close expanded sections when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
            if (this.expandedSection) {
                // Don't close if clicking on sub-page title (let title handler manage it)
                if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.sub-page')) {
                    this.collapseSection();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private expandSection(subPage: HTMLElement, section: 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact'): void {
        // Collapse current section if different
        if (this.expandedSection && this.expandedSection !== subPage) {
            this.collapseSection();
        }

        // Expand new section
        this.expandedSection = subPage;
        subPage.classList.add('expanded');
        
        // Add hint after 10 minutes (changed to 30 seconds for testing)
        setTimeout(() => {
            subPage.classList.add('show-hint');
        }, 30000);
    }

    private collapseSection(): void {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('expanded');
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('show-hint');
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    // Scroll Arrow
    private setupScrollArrow(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.querySelector('.scroll-arrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            scrollArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Scroll to the second page (about section)
                const aboutSection = document.getElementById('about');
                if (aboutSection) {
                    aboutSection.scrollIntoView({ 
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Filter
    private setupPortfolioFilter(): void {
        const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');

        // Initialize: hide all items except 'school' (Academic)
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            if (element.dataset.category === 'school') {
                element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                element.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                element.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        filterButtons.forEach((btn: Element) => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Remove active class from all buttons
                filterButtons.forEach((b: Element) => {
                    b.classList.remove('active');
                });
                
                // Add active class to clicked button
                (btn as HTMLElement).classList.add('active');
                
                // Get filter category
                const filter = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.filter;
                if (filter) {
                    this.filterPortfolioItems(filter);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private filterPortfolioItems(filter: string): void {
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            const category = element.dataset.category;
            
            if (filter === category) {
                element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                element.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                element.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    private setupScrollAnimations(): void {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries: IntersectionObserverEntry[]) => {
            entries.forEach((entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('animate');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe elements that should animate on scroll
        const animateElements = document.querySelectorAll('.page-section, .portfolio-item, .contact-item');
        animateElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    }

    // Contact Form
    private setupContactForm(): void {
        const contactForm = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        
        if (contactForm) {
            contactForm.addEventListener('submit', (e: Event) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.handleFormSubmit(contactForm as HTMLFormElement);
            });
        }
    }

    private handleFormSubmit(form: HTMLFormElement): void {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data = {
            name: formData.get('name') as string,
            email: formData.get('email') as string,
            subject: formData.get('subject') as string,
            message: formData.get('message') as string
        };

        // Simulate form submission
        console.log('Form submitted:', data);
        
        // Show success message
        this.showFormMessage('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
        form.reset();
    }

    private showFormMessage(message: string, type: 'success' | 'error'): void {
        // Create message element
        const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
        messageEl.className = `form-message ${type}`;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        
        // Insert after form
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.parentNode?.insertBefore(messageEl, form.nextSibling);
            
            // Remove message after 3 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
                messageEl.remove();
            }, 3000);
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    private setupKeyboardNavigation(): void {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            switch(e.key) {
                case 'Escape':
                    this.collapseSection();
                    break;
                case '1':
                    this.navigateToPage('about');
                    break;
                case '2':
                    this.navigateToPage('portfolio');
                    break;
                case '3':
                    this.navigateToPage('contact');
                    break;
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    private setupLoadingAnimation(): void {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Cleanup
    public destroy(): void {
        // Clear all eye animation timers
        this.eyeTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
        this.eyeTimers = [];
        
        // Reset expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
    }
}

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
});

            const timer = setTimeout(blink, nextBlink);
            this.eyeTimers.push(timer);
        };
        
        blink();
    }

    // Page Navigation
    private setupPageNavigation(): void {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        
        navItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            item.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                
                const targetPage = (item as HTMLElement).dataset.page;
                if (targetPage) {
                    this.navigateToPage(targetPage);
                }
            });
        });

        // Close expanded sections when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
            if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.nav-item')) {
                this.collapseSection();
            }
        });
    }

    private navigateToPage(page: string): void {
        this.currentPage = page;
        this.updateActiveNavItem(page);
        
        // Scroll to page
        const targetElement = document.getElementById(page);
        if (targetElement) {
            targetElement.scrollIntoView({ 
                behavior: 'smooth',
                block: 'start'
            });
        }
    }

    private updateActiveNavItem(activePage: string): void {
        const navItems = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item');
        navItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            if (element.dataset.page === activePage) {
                element.classList.add('active');
            } else {
                element.classList.remove('active');
            }
        });
    }

    // Sub-page Expansion
    private setupSubPageExpansion(): void {
        const subPages = document.querySelectorAll('.sub-page');
        
        subPages.forEach((subPage: Element) => {
            subPage.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
                // Don't trigger if clicking on form elements
                if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.contact-form') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.filter-btn') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.portfolio-item') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.view-project') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('textarea') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button') ||
                    (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('a')) {
                    return;
                }

                const section = (subPage as HTMLElement).dataset.section;
                if (section) {
                    this.expandSection(subPage as HTMLElement, section as 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact');
                }
            });
        });

        // Close expanded sections when clicking outside
        document.addEventListener('click', (e: Event) => {
            if (this.expandedSection) {
                // Don't close if clicking on sub-page title (let title handler manage it)
                if (!(e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.sub-page')) {
                    this.collapseSection();
                }
            }
        });
    }

    private expandSection(subPage: HTMLElement, section: 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact'): void {
        // Collapse current section if different
        if (this.expandedSection && this.expandedSection !== subPage) {
            this.collapseSection();
        }

        // Expand new section
        this.expandedSection = subPage;
        subPage.classList.add('expanded');
        
        // Add hint after 10 minutes (changed to 30 seconds for testing)
        setTimeout(() => {
            subPage.classList.add('show-hint');
        }, 30000);
    }

    private collapseSection(): void {
        if (this.expandedSection) {
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('expanded');
            this.expandedSection.classList.remove('show-hint');
            this.expandedSection = null;
        }
    }

    // Scroll Arrow
    private setupScrollArrow(): void {
        const scrollArrow = document.querySelector('.scroll-arrow');
        
        if (scrollArrow) {
            scrollArrow.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Scroll to the second page (about section)
                const aboutSection = document.getElementById('about');
                if (aboutSection) {
                    aboutSection.scrollIntoView({ 
                        behavior: 'smooth',
                        block: 'start'
                    });
                }
            });
        }
    }

    // Portfolio Filter
    private setupPortfolioFilter(): void {
        const filterButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');

        // Initialize: hide all items except 'school' (Academic)
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            if (element.dataset.category === 'school') {
                element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                element.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                element.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });

        filterButtons.forEach((btn: Element) => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Remove active class from all buttons
                filterButtons.forEach((b: Element) => {
                    b.classList.remove('active');
                });
                
                // Add active class to clicked button
                (btn as HTMLElement).classList.add('active');
                
                // Get filter category
                const filter = (btn as HTMLElement).dataset.filter;
                if (filter) {
                    this.filterPortfolioItems(filter);
                }
            });
        });
    }

    private filterPortfolioItems(filter: string): void {
        const portfolioItems = document.querySelectorAll('.portfolio-item');
        
        portfolioItems.forEach((item: Element) => {
            const element = item as HTMLElement;
            const category = element.dataset.category;
            
            if (filter === category) {
                element.style.visibility = 'visible';
                element.style.display = 'block';
            } else {
                element.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                element.style.display = 'none';
            }
        });
    }

    // Scroll Animations
    private setupScrollAnimations(): void {
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries: IntersectionObserverEntry[]) => {
            entries.forEach((entry: IntersectionObserverEntry) => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.classList.add('animate');
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        // Observe elements that should animate on scroll
        const animateElements = document.querySelectorAll('.page-section, .portfolio-item, .contact-item');
        animateElements.forEach((el: Element) => {
            observer.observe(el);
        });
    }

    // Contact Form
    private setupContactForm(): void {
        const contactForm = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        
        if (contactForm) {
            contactForm.addEventListener('submit', (e: Event) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                this.handleFormSubmit(contactForm as HTMLFormElement);
            });
        }
    }

    private handleFormSubmit(form: HTMLFormElement): void {
        const formData = new FormData(form);
        const data = {
            name: formData.get('name') as string,
            email: formData.get('email') as string,
            subject: formData.get('subject') as string,
            message: formData.get('message') as string
        };

        // Simulate form submission
        console.log('Form submitted:', data);
        
        // Show success message
        this.showFormMessage('Message sent successfully!', 'success');
        form.reset();
    }

    private showFormMessage(message: string, type: 'success' | 'error'): void {
        // Create message element
        const messageEl = document.createElement('div');
        messageEl.className = `form-message ${type}`;
        messageEl.textContent = message;
        
        // Insert after form
        const form = document.querySelector('.contact-form');
        if (form) {
            form.parentNode?.insertBefore(messageEl, form.nextSibling);
            
            // Remove message after 3 seconds
            setTimeout(() => {
                messageEl.remove();
            }, 3000);
        }
    }

    // Keyboard Navigation
    private setupKeyboardNavigation(): void {
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
            switch(e.key) {
                case 'Escape':
                    this.collapseSection();
                    break;
                case '1':
                    this.navigateToPage('about');
                    break;
                case '2':
                    this.navigateToPage('portfolio');
                    break;
                case '3':
                    this.navigateToPage('contact');
                    break;
            }
        });
    }

    // Loading Animation
    private setupLoadingAnimation(): void {
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
            document.body.classList.add('loaded');
        });
    }

    // Cleanup
    public destroy(): void {
        // Clear all eye animation timers
        this.eyeTimers.forEach(timer => clearTimeout(timer));
        this.eyeTimers = [];
        
        // Reset expanded section
        this.collapseSection();
    }
}

// Initialize the application when DOM is loaded
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    new AdvancedPortfolioApp();
});

# Daniel Wu Portfolio - TypeScript Version

## 專案說明

這是 Daniel Wu 的互動式作品集網站，使用 TypeScript 開發動態網頁功能。

## 技術架構

### 前端技術
- **HTML5**: 網頁結構
- **CSS3**: 樣式設計和動畫效果
- **TypeScript**: 動態網頁功能開發

### 專案結構
```
hw1/
├── index.html              # 主頁面
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── styles.css      # 樣式文件
│   └── js/

## ✅ **TypeScript 轉換問題已修復！**

我已經成功解決了 TypeScript 轉換後按鈕和文字無法點擊的問題：

### **問題原因**
1. **Export 語句問題**: TypeScript 編譯器自動添加了 `export default` 語句，這在瀏覽器中會導致模組系統錯誤
2. **功能缺失**: 第一次轉換時遺漏了許多重要的方法

### **解決方案**
1. **創建完整的 TypeScript 版本**: 重新創建了 `portfolio.ts`，包含所有原始功能
2. **修復編譯配置**: 設置 `module: "none"` 避免模組系統
3. **移除 Export 語句**: 確保編譯後的 JavaScript 可以在瀏覽器中直接運行
4. **類型安全**: 添加了完整的 TypeScript 類型定義

### **現在可用的功能**
✅ **圓形游標**: 自定義游標效果  
✅ **眼睛動畫**: 隨機眨眼動畫  
✅ **頁面導航**: 滾動和鍵盤導航  
✅ **子頁面展開**: 圓形輻射展開動畫  
✅ **作品集篩選**: 動態篩選功能  
✅ **聯絡表單**: 表單處理和驗證  
✅ **響應式設計**: 適配不同螢幕尺寸

- 所有按鈕和文字現在都可以正常點擊！

- 完整的類型定義
- 嚴格類型檢查

# 助教檢查說明 - Daniel Wu 作品集網站

## 📋 作業要求檢查清單

### ✅ HTML 結構
- **文件位置**: `index.html`
- **檢查項目**: 
  - 完整的 HTML5 結構
  - 語義化標籤使用
  - 響應式設計 meta 標籤
  - 無障礙設計 (alt 屬性等)

### ✅ CSS 樣式設計
- **文件位置**: `assets/css/styles.css`
- **檢查項目**:
  - 現代化 CSS3 樣式
  - 動畫效果 (@keyframes)
  - 響應式設計 (@media queries)
  - 視覺設計 (顏色、字體、佈局)

### ✅ JavaScript 動態功能
- **文件位置**: `assets/js/script.js`
- **檢查項目**:
  - 互動功能完整
  - 事件處理
  - DOM 操作
  - 動畫控制

## 🚀 如何啟動網站

### 方法一：使用 Python (推薦)
```bash
# 在專案目錄中執行
python3 -m http.server 8005

# 然後在瀏覽器打開
http://localhost:8005
```

### 方法二：直接打開文件
- 雙擊 `index.html` 文件
- 在瀏覽器中打開

## 🎯 主要功能測試

### 1. 圓形游標效果
- **測試方法**: 移動滑鼠
- **預期結果**: 自定義圓形游標跟隨滑鼠移動

### 2. 眼睛動畫
- **測試方法**: 觀察頁面上的眼睛圖標
- **預期結果**: 眼睛會隨機眨眼

### 3. 頁面導航
- **測試方法**: 點擊導航按鈕 (ABOUT, PORTFOLIO, CONTACT)
- **預期結果**: 平滑滾動到對應頁面

### 4. 子頁面展開
- **測試方法**: 點擊子頁面任意區域
- **預期結果**: 圓形輻射展開動畫

### 5. 作品集篩選
- **測試方法**: 點擊 Academic, Research, Personal 按鈕
- **預期結果**: 作品項目動態篩選顯示

### 6. 聯絡表單
- **測試方法**: 填寫並提交表單
- **預期結果**: 表單驗證和提交處理

### 7. 鍵盤導航
- **測試方法**: 按 ESC, 1, 2, 3 鍵
- **預期結果**: 對應的頁面操作

### 8. 響應式設計
- **測試方法**: 調整瀏覽器視窗大小
- **預期結果**: 佈局自動適應螢幕尺寸

## 📁 檔案結構

```
hw1/
├── index.html                    # 主頁面
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   └── styles.css           # 樣式文件
│   └── js/
│       └── script.js            # JavaScript 功能
├── 助教檢查說明.md              # 本說明文件
└── README.md                    # 專案說明
```

## 🔍 技術特點

### JavaScript 功能
- **類別導向設計**: 使用 ES6 Class
- **事件驅動**: 完整的 DOM 事件處理
- **動畫控制**: CSS 動畫的 JavaScript 控制
- **模組化**: 清晰的方法分離

### 視覺設計
- **現代化 UI**: 簡潔美觀的介面設計
- **動畫效果**: 豐富的 CSS3 動畫

- **直觀操作**: 簡單易懂的互動方式

```markdown
# Daniel Wu 個人作品集網站

## 🎨 設計概念

### 核心理念：融合學術與創意
這個作品集網站以「學術專業與創意表達的完美融合」為設計核心，展現一個工科學生在技術能力與藝術美感之間的平衡。網站不僅是作品展示平台，更是一個互動體驗空間。

### 視覺設計語言
- **色彩系統**：以溫暖的米黃色為主調，象徵知識的溫暖和學術的深度
- **幾何元素**：大量運用圓形和曲線，代表思維的流暢和創意的無限
- **空間層次**：通過深淺變化和透明度營造立體感，引導視覺焦點

## 🌟 內容架構

### 主頁 Hero Section
**「DANI EYE WU DREAMER」**
- 設計靈感：眼睛代表觀察與洞察，夢想家代表無限可能
- 互動元素：眼睛隨機眨眼動畫，象徵活躍的思維
- 視覺效果：自定義圓形游標，營造獨特的瀏覽體驗

### ABOUT 關於我
**學術背景展示**
- 內容重點：學術歷程、研究興趣、學習成果
- 設計特色：白色內容框浮於背景之上，突出文字內容
- 背景元素：台灣大學圖書館，體現學術環境的莊重感

### PORTFOLIO 作品集
**三維展示空間**
- **Academic 學術作品**：課業專案、研究成果
- **Research 研究專案**：深度研究、學術論文
- **Personal 個人創作**：創意專案、興趣作品

**互動設計**：
- 動態篩選系統，讓訪客按興趣探索
- 圓形輻射展開動畫，象徵創意的爆發
- 作品卡片設計，平衡資訊密度與視覺美感

### CONTACT 聯絡方式
**多元聯絡渠道**
- **Instagram**：@daniel_wu_creative - 視覺創作分享
- **Facebook**：Daniel Wu - 社交網絡連結
- **LinkedIn**：Daniel Wu - Creative Developer - 專業網路展示

## 🎭 互動設計哲學

### 微互動設計
1. **圓形游標**：打破傳統游標的線性思維，圓形代表包容與完整
2. **眼睛動畫**：隨機眨眼創造生命感，讓靜態頁面充滿活力
3. **輻射展開**：從中心向外擴散的動畫，象徵創意從內心向外傳遞

### 用戶體驗考量
- **直觀導航**：清晰的頁面結構，降低學習成本
- **響應式設計**：適應各種設備，確保一致的使用體驗
- **無障礙設計**：支援鍵盤導航，照顧不同用戶需求

## 🏛️ 文化元素融入

### 台灣大學背景
- 選擇台大圖書館作為背景，體現對學術環境的尊重
- 淡色濾鏡處理，既保持背景的存在感，又不干擾內容閱讀
- 象徵知識的殿堂與個人成長的搖籃

### 學術氛圍營造
- 穩重的色彩搭配，營造專業可信的氛圍
- 清晰的資訊層次，便於快速獲取關鍵資訊
- 平衡的視覺權重，避免過度裝飾影響內容傳達

## 🎪 創意表達

### 動畫語言
- **進入動畫**：圓形擴散代表思維的展開
- **過渡動畫**：平滑的頁面切換，營造流暢的瀏覽體驗
- **回饋動畫**：按鈕點擊、游標懸停等微動畫，提供即時反饋

### 視覺敘事
- 通過色彩、形狀、動畫的組合，講述一個工科生的創意旅程
- 每個設計元素都有其象徵意義，共同構建完整的視覺故事
- 平衡專業性與趣味性，展現多面向的人格特質

## 🌈 設計創新點

### 獨特元素
1. **眼睛動畫系統**：獨創的隨機眨眼機制，增加頁面生命力
2. **圓形游標設計**：顛覆傳統游標概念，創造獨特互動體驗
3. **輻射展開動畫**：創新的頁面展開方式，視覺衝擊力強
4. **三維作品集空間**：立體的內容組織方式，提升瀏覽趣味

### 技術實現
- 純淨的程式碼架構，確保快速載入和穩定運行
- 模組化的功能設計，便於維護和擴展
- 優化的動畫性能，保證流暢的用戶體驗

## 🎯 目標受眾

### 主要對象
- **學術界同仁**：展示研究能力和學術成果
- **業界專業人士**：展現技術實力和創意思維
- **潛在合作夥伴**：建立專業形象和信任感

### 傳達訊息

/**
 * TypeScript 類型定義文件

// 頁面類型定義
export type PageType = 'hero' | 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact';

// 子頁面區塊類型
export type SectionType = 'about' | 'portfolio' | 'contact';

// 作品集分類類型
export type PortfolioCategory = 'school' | 'lab' | 'hobby';

// 眼睛動畫相關類型
export interface EyeAnimation {
  element: HTMLElement;
  timer?: number;
  isBlinking: boolean;
}

// 作品集項目類型
export interface PortfolioItem {
  element: HTMLElement;
  category: PortfolioCategory;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  isVisible: boolean;
  animationDelay: number;
}

// 聯絡表單數據類型
export interface ContactFormData {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  subject: string;
  message: string;
}

// 動畫配置類型
export interface AnimationConfig {
  duration: number;
  easing: string;
  delay: number;
}

// 響應式斷點類型
export interface BreakpointConfig {
  mobile: number;
  tablet: number;
  desktop: number;
}

// 游標狀態類型
export interface CursorState {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  isHovering: boolean;
  scale: number;
}

// 頁面狀態類型
export interface PageState {
  currentPage: PageType;
  expandedSection: SectionType | null;
  isAnimating: boolean;
  isLoaded: boolean;
}

// 事件處理器類型
export type EventHandler<T = Event> = (event: T) => void;

// DOM 元素選擇器類型
export type Selector = string | HTMLElement | NodeListOf<HTMLElement>;

// 動畫回調函數類型
export type AnimationCallback = () => void;

// 表單驗證結果類型
export interface ValidationResult {
  isValid: boolean;
  errors: string[];
}

// 作品集篩選配置類型
export interface FilterConfig {
  activeFilter: PortfolioCategory | 'all';
  transitionDuration: number;
  staggerDelay: number;
}

// 鍵盤快捷鍵類型
export interface KeyboardShortcut {
  key: string;
  ctrlKey?: boolean;
  shiftKey?: boolean;
  altKey?: boolean;
  action: () => void;
}

// 滾動動畫配置類型
export interface ScrollAnimationConfig {
  threshold: number;
  rootMargin: string;
  triggerOnce: boolean;
}

// 媒體查詢配置類型
export interface MediaQueryConfig {
  query: string;
  callback: (matches: boolean) => void;
}

// 應用程式主要介面類型
export interface PortfolioApp {
  currentPage: PageType;
  eyeTimers: number[];
  expandedSection: HTMLElement | null;
  portfolioItems: PortfolioItem[];
  cursorState: CursorState;
  pageState: PageState;
  
  init(): void;
  destroy(): void;
  navigateToPage(page: PageType): void;
  expandSection(section: SectionType): void;
  collapseSection(): void;
  filterPortfolio(category: PortfolioCategory): void;
  handleFormSubmit(data: ContactFormData): void;
}
